resources.name: Food Bank for Larimer County - Loveland

resources.name: UCHealth Family Medicine Center Food Pantry

resources.address: 1025 Pennock Pl, Suite 109, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.address: 3901 S Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80525

resources.name: St. John's Lutheran Church Food Pantry

resources.address: 305 E Elizabeth St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Mobile Food Pantry at Foothills Unitarian Church
resources.description: Food Bank for Larimer County mobile pantry with free fresh produce and groceries. Drive-through or walk up.

resources.name: NoCo CommUNITY Store

resources.address: 437 N Garfield Ave, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: WIC - Larimer County
resources.description: Free healthy food, nutrition help and breastfeeding support for pregnant women, new moms, infants and kids under 5. Fort Collins office at 1525 Blue Spruce Dr; Loveland/Estes/Berthoud call 970-619-4590.
resources.address: 1525 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Hunger Free Colorado Food Resource Hotline
resources.description: Statewide hotline that helps you apply for SNAP (food stamps) and find pantries and meal programs near you. Multilingual.

resources.name: McBackpack

resources.address: Fort Collins, CO

resources.name: Larimer County Human Services - Benefits
resources.description: Apply for SNAP (food stamps), Medicaid / Health First Colorado, TANF cash assistance, child care assistance and more. Offices in Fort Collins (1501 Blue Spruce Dr), Loveland (200 Peridot Ave) and Estes Park (1601 Brodie Ave).
resources.address: 1501 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Colorado PEAK (apply online)

resources.name: Social Security Administration - Fort Collins
resources.description: Apply for SSI, SSDI and retirement benefits, replace a Social Security card, or check on a claim. Appointments are strongly recommended; call the local office or 1-800-772-1213.
resources.address: 301 S Howes St, 4th Floor, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: City of Fort Collins Rebate Program
resources.description: Yearly cash rebates on sales tax, utilities and property tax/rent for income-qualified Fort Collins residents. One application covers all rebates.
resources.address: 215 N Mason St, 2nd Floor, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Get FoCo

resources.name: Get FoCo Recreation Pass (therapy pools)
resources.description: Income-qualified Fort Collins rec pass: about $45/year for an adult after approval, with unlimited visits to city rec facilities including EPIC's warm-water therapy pool, City Park Pool, Mulberry Pool, and the Senior Center. Apply at Get FoCo, wait for approval, then buy the reduced pass. For in-person help, go downstairs at UCHealth Family Medicine, 1025 Pennock Place, and ask for Robert in Med 9.
resources.hours: Online 24/7; rec facilities have their own hours

resources.name: Larimer Health Connect
resources.description: Free, unbiased help enrolling in Health First Colorado (Medicaid), CHP+ or a Connect for Health Colorado marketplace plan. Walk in or make an appointment.
resources.address: 144 N Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: UCHealth Financial Assistance
resources.description: Discounts or free care on UCHealth hospital and clinic bills for patients who qualify by income. You can apply before or after you get a bill.

resources.name: Make Change NOCO - Free Tax Preparation
resources.description: Free IRS-certified tax preparation (VITA) so you can claim the Earned Income Credit, Child Tax Credit and Colorado credits like TABOR and the Family Affordability Credit.
resources.address: 2601 S Lemay Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80525
resources.hours: Tax season (Jan-Apr) by appointment; year-round help by phone

resources.name: LEAP - Low-income Energy Assistance Program
resources.description: Helps pay winter heating bills (Nov 1 - Apr 30). Getting LEAP in Fort Collins also automatically enrolls you in the Utilities Income-Qualified Assistance Program for a discount on your city bill.

resources.name: Fort Collins Utilities Payment Assistance Fund
resources.description: One-time help paying a past-due Fort Collins Utilities bill, administered by Catholic Charities. Bring your shut-off or past-due notice.
resources.address: 460 Linden Center Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Fort Collins Utilities Income-Qualified Assistance Program
resources.description: Roughly 25% off electric, water and wastewater rates on your Fort Collins Utilities bill. Enroll through LEAP or Get FoCo.
resources.address: 222 Laporte Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Loveland Water & Power - HAND Program
resources.description: Help paying Loveland utility bills for residents with low income, disability or over 60. Administered with House of Neighborly Service.
resources.address: 200 N Wilson Ave, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Energy Outreach Colorado
resources.description: Bill payment help when LEAP isn't enough, plus free furnace/water heater repair or replacement for income-qualified homeowners (crisis line 855-469-4328).

resources.name: Xcel Energy - Payment Plans & Assistance
resources.description: If Xcel is your gas provider, call to set up a payment plan, request a medical hold, or ask about the Energy Assistance and Percentage of Income Payment programs.

resources.name: Housing Catalyst

resources.address: 1715 W Mountain Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.description: Section 8 vouchers, affordable rentals and senior housing for the Loveland area. Also runs the Larimer Home Improvement Program for low-cost home repair loans.

resources.name: Estes Park Housing Authority

resources.address: 363 E Elkhorn Ave, Suite 101, Estes Park, CO 80517

resources.name: CARE Housing

resources.address: 1303 W Swallow Rd, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: Neighbor to Neighbor - Loveland
resources.description: Rent and utility assistance, eviction prevention and housing counseling for Loveland, Berthoud and southern Larimer County.
resources.address: 375 W 37th St, Suite 100, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Fort Collins Habitat for Humanity
resources.description: Affordable homeownership with a zero-interest mortgage for families who put in sweat-equity hours, plus a home repair program. Call about the next application window.

resources.name: Loveland Habitat for Humanity
resources.description: Affordable homeownership and home repair programs for the Loveland and Berthoud area.
resources.address: 108 W 29th St, Unit D, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Volunteers of America - Northern Colorado
resources.description: Supportive housing and rapid re-housing for veterans (SSVF), affordable senior housing, and Meals on Wheels partnerships across Larimer and Weld counties.
resources.address: 405 Canyon Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Colorado Poverty Law Project - Eviction Help
resources.description: Free legal help for tenants facing eviction, illegal lockouts or unsafe housing. Statewide tenant help line.

resources.address: 1501 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.address: 117 N Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Catholic Charities - The Mission / Samaritan House
resources.description: Overnight shelter for women and families with children, hot meals, case management and help with IDs and utilities. Same building houses the Fort Collins Utilities payment assistance program.
resources.address: 460 Linden Center Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Family Housing Network
resources.description: Shelter and a day center for families with children under 18 who are experiencing homelessness, plus help getting back into stable housing.
resources.address: 1606 S Lemay Ave, Suite 103, Fort Collins, CO 80525
resources.hours: Day center Mon-Fri; call for intake

resources.name: Murphy Center for Hope (Homeward Alliance)
resources.description: Day resource center for anyone experiencing or at risk of homelessness: showers, laundry, mail, phone, lockers, bus passes, benefits help, job search help and 20+ partner agencies under one roof.
resources.address: 242 Conifer St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Loveland Resource Center & Overnight Shelter
resources.description: Daytime resource center with showers, laundry, meals and case management, plus an overnight shelter for adults in Loveland.
resources.address: 137 S Lincoln Ave, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Loveland Overnight Shelter - South Railroad
resources.description: City of Loveland overnight shelter for adults. Doors open at 7pm.
resources.address: 300 S Railroad Ave, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Family Promise of Larimer County (HNS)
resources.description: Shelter and rehousing program for families with children in Loveland and southern Larimer County, run by House of Neighborly Service.
resources.address: 1511 E 11th St, Suite 200, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Harvest Farm - New Life Program
resources.description: Free long-term residential recovery program for men overcoming homelessness and addiction, on a working farm near Wellington (Denver Rescue Mission).
resources.address: 4240 E County Rd 66, Wellington, CO 80549

resources.description: Free job search help, resume and interview coaching, training scholarships (WIOA), youth programs and hiring events. Computers, printers and phones available for job seekers. Loveland services are at the 200 Peridot Ave campus.
resources.address: 200 W Oak St, Suite 5000, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Connecting Colorado
resources.description: Colorado's official job board. Create a profile, search openings statewide and register for workforce center services. Required for unemployment work-search.

resources.name: Colorado Division of Vocational Rehabilitation - Loveland
resources.description: Free help finding and keeping a job if you have a disability: career counseling, training, assistive technology, job coaching and Ticket to Work. Serves Fort Collins, Loveland and Estes Park.
resources.address: 5250 Hahns Peak Dr, Suite 120, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Disabled Resource Services - Fort Collins

resources.address: 1017 Robertson St, Unit B, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Disabled Resource Services - Loveland
resources.description: Independent living services for people with disabilities in Loveland, Berthoud and Estes Park: benefits help, peer support, advocacy, equipment loans, and Deaf / hard-of-hearing / low-vision navigation.
resources.address: 1647 E 18th St, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Fort Collins Adaptive Recreation (ARO)
resources.description: City recreation for people with disabilities: inclusion support in regular classes, specialized programs, adaptive swim lessons, equipment rental, and help using city pools. resources.address: 1200 Raintree Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80526
resources.hours: Mon-Fri; call or email for intake

resources.name: Spirit Crossing Clubhouse
resources.description: Free membership community for adults living with mental illness. Members build work skills, get help finding transitional and supported employment, and share meals. Peer-run.
resources.address: 1148 E Elizabeth St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Junior League Career Closet (closed)
resources.description: This closet closed on May 31, 2025. For free work or interview clothes, ask at the Workforce Center (200 W Oak, 5th floor), the Murphy Center Gear Room on Conifer, or the Salvation Army Care Closet at 3901 S Mason. Call 2-1-1 if you need a current referral.
resources.address: Fort Collins, CO

resources.name: Poudre Libraries - Job & Career Center
resources.description: Free computers, WiFi, printing and one-on-one help with resumes and job applications at Old Town, Harmony and Council Tree libraries. Online resume coaching through BrainFuse daily 3pm-midnight with your library card.
resources.address: 201 Peterson St, Fort Collins, CO 80524
resources.hours: Old Town: Mon-Thu 9am-8pm; Fri 9am-6pm; Sat 9am-5pm; Sun 12-5pm

resources.name: CareerOneStop (U.S. Dept. of Labor)
resources.description: National site for exploring careers, comparing wages, finding training, and locating unemployment and workforce services. Includes a resume guide and interview tips.

resources.name: My Next Move (O*NET)
resources.description: Answer 60 quick questions about what you like to do and get career suggestions matched to your interests, with the training each one needs.

resources.name: Apprenticeship.gov
resources.description: Find paid apprenticeships where you earn a wage while learning a trade or skilled career. Search by location and industry.

resources.name: TaskRabbit (flexible gig work)
resources.description: Get paid for odd jobs like furniture assembly, moving help, yard work and errands on your own schedule. Good for flexible income while you look for steady work.

resources.name: Fuerza Latina
resources.description: Support, advocacy and know-your-rights information for immigrant and Latino community members in Larimer County. Immigrant emergency hotline: 970-472-1501.
resources.address: Fort Collins, CO

resources.name: Front Range Community College - Larimer Campus
resources.description: Affordable degrees, certificates and job-training programs. Financial aid, Colorado's free community college programs for some fields, and GED/ESL classes. Advising: 970-204-8332.
resources.address: 4616 S Shields St, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: Poudre Libraries - Adult Learning & GED Prep
resources.description: Free GED practice tests, live online tutors, LinkedIn Learning courses and language learning with a free library card. Cards are free for Larimer County residents.
resources.address: 201 Peterson St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Cultural Enrichment Center of Fort Collins
resources.description: Academic, career and cultural programs for African American middle and high school students in Fort Collins.
resources.address: 1825 E Mulberry St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: freeCodeCamp
resources.description: Free coding lessons and certificates you can put on a resume. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, data analysis and more. You finish real projects; no paywall.

resources.name: Harvard CS50
resources.description: Harvard's intro computer science course, free online. Finish it on cs50.harvard.edu for a free CS50 certificate. The optional edX 'verified' seal costs money; you do not need it.

resources.name: Google Skillshop
resources.description: Free Google certificates for Ads, Analytics, and Business Profile. Take the courses and exams on Google's site at no cost.

resources.name: HubSpot Academy
resources.description: Free certificates in inbound marketing, sales, content, and CRM. Good resume lines if you want office, sales, or marketing work.

resources.name: IBM SkillsBuild
resources.description: Free IBM credentials in AI basics, data, cybersecurity, and job-ready tech skills. No fee for the learning or the badges.

resources.name: Microsoft Learn
resources.description: Free Microsoft training and badges for Azure, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and AI. The big certification exams (like AZ-900) still cost money; the learning paths and badges do not.

resources.name: Cisco Skills for All (Networking Academy)
resources.description: Free intro courses and badges in networking, cybersecurity, and IT basics from Cisco. A starting point if you want help-desk or network work.

resources.name: Salesforce Trailhead
resources.description: Free Salesforce badges and Superbadges. Useful if you want admin, CRM, or customer-service software jobs.

resources.name: MongoDB University
resources.description: Free MongoDB courses and certificates for databases used in a lot of web jobs. Pair this with freeCodeCamp if you are learning to code.

resources.name: Semrush Academy
resources.description: Free SEO and content-marketing certificates. A practical add-on if you want marketing or website work.

resources.name: Coursera (Google Career Certificates + financial aid)
resources.description: Google Career Certificates (IT Support, Data Analytics, UX, Project Management and more) live here. Lessons can be audited free. The shareable certificate usually needs Coursera financial aid — apply on the course page — or a workforce program that pays.

resources.name: FEMA Independent Study (emergency management)
resources.description: Free official FEMA courses and certificates (IS-100, IS-200, IS-700, IS-800 and about 200 more). Used for emergency management, CERT, and some government or nonprofit jobs. You need a free FEMA Student ID.

resources.name: IRS Link & Learn Taxes (VITA/TCE certification)
resources.description: Free IRS training and certification to prepare taxes as a VITA or TCE volunteer. Passing the Volunteer Standards of Conduct and a tax-law exam (80%) is a real credential for tax and bookkeeping work. Pair it with a local VITA site if you want practice hours.

resources.name: Colorado Mandatory Reporter Training
resources.description: Free official Colorado Child Welfare Training System course (about 2 hours, English or Spanish). Many school, child-care, health, and social-service jobs require this certificate. Save or print it at the end — the site does not store it. Do not create an account; use Public Training.

resources.name: CareerOneStop Certification Finder
resources.description: U.S. Department of Labor search tool for occupational licenses and certificates by job title and state. Use this when you want to know which credential a Colorado employer actually asks for. It is a directory, not a course.

resources.name: My Colorado Journey
resources.description: State of Colorado site to explore careers, compare training, and find education and workforce programs. Good next step after a certificate if you want in-state classes, apprenticeships, or aid.

resources.name: SBA Learning Platform (MySBA Learning)
resources.description: Free U.S. Small Business Administration courses on starting and running a small business. Some live SBA workshops also give a completion certificate. This is government training, not a paid business-school diploma.

resources.name: Intuit Academy (bookkeeping)
resources.description: Free bookkeeping and tax courses on Intuit's own Academy site, including the Intuit Bookkeeping Certification for U.S. residents. Use academy.intuit.com — the Coursera version of this program is a paid subscription.

resources.name: Northstar Digital Literacy
resources.description: Free assessments and certificates for computer basics, email, Word, Excel, and job-search skills. Workforce centers and libraries across the U.S. use these. Ask Poudre Libraries or the Larimer Workforce Center if they can proctor a session.

resources.name: GCFGlobal (Goodwill Community Foundation)
resources.description: Free lessons on computers, Microsoft Office, Google tools, job search, and everyday tech from Goodwill Community Foundation. A solid start if you are not ready for a coding bootcamp-style certificate.

resources.name: AWS Skill Builder
resources.description: Free Amazon Web Services training and some digital badges. The big AWS certification exams (Cloud Practitioner and others) still cost money; the learning paths do not.

resources.name: Google Cloud Skills Boost
resources.description: Free Google Cloud skill badges and labs with a monthly free allotment. Useful for cloud or data work. The official Google Cloud certification exams cost money.

resources.name: Colorado Works (TANF)
resources.description: Monthly cash assistance plus job training and support services for families with children. Apply through Larimer County Human Services or Colorado PEAK.
resources.address: 1501 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Social Security Disability (SSI / SSDI) - Apply Online

resources.address: 1501 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Health District of Northern Larimer County

resources.hours: Mon-Fri 8am-5pm; ask the front desk to point you downstairs

Free food pantry is in Suite 109.
resources.address: 1025 Pennock Pl, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Larimer County Department of Health & Environment
resources.description: Immunizations, family planning, WIC, STI testing and public health services on a sliding scale. Offices in Fort Collins, Loveland and Estes Park.
resources.address: 1525 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: UCHealth Mountain Crest Behavioral Health Center
resources.description: Inpatient and outpatient mental health and substance use treatment, including a 24/7 behavioral health assessment line.
resources.address: 4601 Corbett Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80528

resources.name: La Cocina
resources.description: Free, bilingual (Spanish/English) mental health care and peer support for immigrant and Latino families. No insurance needed.
resources.address: Fort Collins, CO

resources.name: CSU Psychological Services Center
resources.description: Low-cost counseling for adults, kids and couples on a sliding scale, provided by supervised doctoral students at Colorado State University.
resources.address: 1620 Center Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80523

resources.name: Open Path Psychotherapy Collective
resources.description: Affordable in-person and online therapy ($40-$80 per session) for people without insurance or with high deductibles. One-time lifetime membership fee.

resources.name: Ensight Skills Center (low vision)
resources.description: Low-vision rehabilitation, adaptive technology training and support for people losing their sight. Sliding-scale fees.
resources.address: 1740 S College Ave, Suite 200, Fort Collins, CO 80525

resources.name: Lions Club Eyeglass Assistance
resources.description: Volunteer help paying for eye exams and glasses for people who cannot afford them. Lions Clubs across Larimer County run this program. Fort Collins Lions 970-377-2282; Loveland Lions 970-622-9799.
resources.address: Fort Collins, CO
resources.hours: Leave a message; volunteers return calls

resources.name: Transfort (Fort Collins city buses)
resources.description: Fort Collins buses, including MAX, are fare-free. Routes changed Aug 17, 2026 and there is no Sunday service. For door-to-door paratransit see Transfort Dial-A-Ride on the Have a disability? tab.
resources.address: 250 N Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: COLT (City of Loveland Transit)
resources.description: Loveland city buses and paratransit. Youth ride free; reduced fares for seniors and riders with disabilities. Connects to Transfort's FLEX route.
resources.address: Loveland, CO

resources.name: SAINT (Senior Alternatives in Transportation)
resources.description: Free volunteer-driven rides for adults 60+ and adults with disabilities in Fort Collins and Loveland. Book rides at least 3 days ahead.
resources.address: 333 W Drake Rd, Suite 42, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: Medicaid Rides (Transdev Health Solutions)
resources.description: Free rides to medical appointments for Health First Colorado (Medicaid) members. Book at least 2 business days ahead.

resources.name: Ride NOCO
resources.description: Mobility specialists who help you figure out how to get anywhere in Northern Colorado: buses, volunteer rides, paratransit, vouchers and more.

resources.name: Bustang North Line (Fort Collins to Denver)
resources.description: CDOT's low-cost express bus from Fort Collins and Loveland to Denver. Discounts for seniors, disabled riders and students.
resources.address: 250 N Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: BATS (Berthoud Area Transportation Service)
resources.description: Door-to-door rides within Berthoud and to Loveland, Longmont and Fort Collins for medical trips. Call ahead.
resources.address: Berthoud, CO 80513

resources.name: The Peak (Estes Park transit)
resources.description: Free town shuttle around Estes Park; seasonal schedule. Includes paratransit for riders with disabilities.
resources.address: Estes Park, CO 80517

resources.name: Poudre Express (Fort Collins - Windsor - Greeley)
resources.description: Regional bus connecting Fort Collins, Windsor and Greeley on weekdays. Low fare; free for seniors 60+ and riders with disabilities with ID.
resources.address: Fort Collins, CO

resources.name: VanGo Vanpool
resources.description: Shared commuter vans between Northern Colorado and Denver/Boulder for people with a regular work schedule. Monthly fare covers gas, van and insurance.

resources.name: Lifeline Phone & Internet Discount
resources.description: Federal program that gives a monthly discount on phone or internet service if you get Medicaid, SNAP, SSI or have low income. Check eligibility and find providers.

resources.name: Assurance Wireless (free Lifeline phone)
resources.description: Free smartphone with monthly talk, text and data for people who qualify for Lifeline (Medicaid, SNAP, SSI or by income).

resources.name: SafeLink Wireless (free Lifeline phone)
resources.description: Free monthly cell service through Lifeline. Bring your own phone or get one from SafeLink.

resources.name: Life Wireless (free Lifeline phone)
resources.description: Free Lifeline cell service with talk, text and data for eligible Colorado residents.

resources.name: Xfinity Internet Essentials
resources.description: Low-cost home internet (about $10-$30/month) for households on Medicaid, SNAP, SSI, housing assistance or free school lunch. Low-cost laptops available.

resources.name: Colorado Legal Services - Fort Collins
resources.description: Free civil legal help for low-income residents: evictions, public benefits (SSI, Medicaid, SNAP denials), family law, consumer issues and protection orders.
resources.address: 215 W Oak St, Suite 800, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Ask-a-Lawyer Clinic (Larimer County Bar)
resources.description: Free 15-minute consultations with volunteer attorneys on the 2nd Tuesday of each month. Call ahead to register.
resources.address: 201 Laporte Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Larimer County Bar Association - Pro Bono Program
resources.description: Connects low-income Larimer County residents with volunteer attorneys for free or reduced-fee representation.
resources.address: Fort Collins, CO

resources.name: Larimer County Court Self-Help Center
resources.description: Free help from court staff understanding forms and procedures for eviction, divorce, protection orders, small claims and name changes. Cannot give legal advice.
resources.address: 201 Laporte Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Larimer County Aging & Disability Resources
resources.description: Options counseling, in-home services, Medicaid long-term care waivers, caregiver support and adult protective services for older adults and adults with disabilities.
resources.address: 1501 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Catholic Charities Senior Services
resources.description: Free help for adults 60+ with benefits applications, housing, transportation, minor home repairs and staying independent. Located at the Murphy Center.
resources.address: 242 Conifer St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: UCHealth Aspen Club
resources.description: Free membership program for adults 50+ with Medicare counseling, health screenings, classes and help navigating care.
resources.address: 1025 Pennock Pl, Suite 111, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Fort Collins Senior Center
resources.description: Low-cost fitness, classes, meals and social programs for adults 50+. Reduced-fee passes available through Get FoCo.
resources.address: 1200 Raintree Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: Chilson Senior Center (Loveland)
resources.description: Programs, lunches, fitness and resource help for Loveland adults 50+.
resources.address: 700 E 4th St, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Larimer County Children, Youth & Family Services
resources.description: Child care assistance (CCCAP), family support, kinship care and child welfare services.
resources.address: 1501 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Kids Closet
resources.description: Free gently used clothing for children, newborn through size 16, at First United Methodist Church. No paperwork needed.
resources.address: 1005 Stover St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Clothe the People
resources.description: Free clothing, hygiene items, and survival gear for anyone. No paperwork. Distros are with Food Not Bombs. Sunday often has a free book exchange. The Oak Street church they used is closed, so confirm the spot before you go.
resources.hours: Often Wed 5-7pm and Sun 2:15pm. Check their site or Instagram for this week's location.

resources.name: The Learning House
resources.description: Free parenting classes, family coaching and early childhood support for Larimer County families.
resources.address: Fort Collins, CO

resources.name: Head Start / Early Head Start (Poudre School District)
resources.description: Free preschool, health screenings and family support for income-qualified children birth to 5. Ask your neighborhood elementary school or call PSD Early Childhood.
resources.address: Fort Collins, CO

resources.name: Poudre Valley Early Head Start (PSD)
resources.description: Free prenatal through age 3 for Larimer County families: weekly home visits with a family specialist, plus limited infant/toddler classroom spots. Income within 130% of poverty or categorical (homeless, foster/kinship, SSI, TANF, SNAP). Apply year-round through PSD Early Childhood — waitlist is needs-based, not first-come. Head Start preschool for 3–4 year olds is a separate application at the same office.
resources.address: Fullana Learning Center, 220 N Grant Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: El Nidito Early Head Start (The Family Center)
resources.description: The only center-based Early Head Start classroom in Larimer County. Infants and toddlers under 3, in partnership with Poudre School District. Apply through PSD Early Childhood, not at the classroom door. The Family Center / La Familia is at this address for other family help too.
resources.address: 309 Hickory Street #5, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Gabriel House (Marisol Health)
resources.description: Free diapers, wipes, formula, baby clothes and gear for families with young children. Also parenting support. The old Dream Room inventory was donated here.
resources.address: 101 N Howes St, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Birthline of Loveland
resources.description: Free diapers, formula, baby clothes, maternity clothes and pregnancy support for Loveland-area families.
resources.address: Loveland, CO

resources.name: Sleep in Heavenly Peace - Northern Colorado
resources.description: Free, hand-built twin beds with bedding for kids ages 3-17 who don't have a bed of their own. Apply online.

resources.name: Homeward Alliance Family Services
resources.description: Case management, rental assistance and school support for Larimer County families with children who are homeless or at risk of losing housing.
resources.address: 242 Conifer St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Larimer County Veterans Service Office
resources.description: Free help filing VA disability claims, pensions, health care enrollment and survivor benefits. Accredited officers; walk-ins welcome.
resources.address: 200 W Oak St, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Fort Collins Vet Center
resources.description: Free, confidential counseling for combat veterans and their families, including PTSD, military sexual trauma and bereavement. No VA enrollment needed.
resources.address: 702 W Drake Rd, Building C, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: VOA Supportive Services for Veteran Families (SSVF)
resources.description: Rapid rehousing, rent and deposit help, and homelessness prevention for veterans and their families in Northern Colorado.
resources.address: 405 Canyon Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Healing Warriors Program
resources.description: Free non-narcotic pain and PTSD care (acupuncture, craniosacral therapy, Healing Touch) for veterans, service members and their families.
resources.address: Fort Collins, CO

resources.name: VA Benefits Hotline
resources.description: National VA line for questions about disability compensation, pension, education benefits and claim status.

resources.name: American Legion Post 4 (Fort Collins)
resources.description: Veteran community, camaraderie and help connecting with benefits and local resources.
resources.address: 2124 W County Rd 54G, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Larimer County Child Care Assistance (CCAP)
resources.description: Helps income-eligible families pay for licensed or qualified child care if you work, look for work, or are in school or Colorado Works. Apply on PEAK; call if you cannot finish the application online.
resources.address: 1501 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Colorado Shines (find licensed child care)
resources.description: Statewide search for licensed child care and preschool by ZIP, hours, and quality rating. Call for a free navigator who can also explain CCAP. The local Larimer search is Larimer Child Care Connect.
resources.hours: Referral line Mon-Fri 8am-5pm; search online anytime

resources.name: Larimer Child Care Connect (NoCo Kids Thrive)
resources.description: Free Larimer County search for openings in child care, preschool, and school-age programs. Run by Northern Colorado Kids Thrive (formerly the Early Childhood Council).
resources.address: 424 Pine St, Ste 201, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Teaching Tree Early Childhood - Fort Collins
resources.description: Nonprofit infant through preschool care with sliding-scale tuition based on family income. Founded to serve low- and middle-income families. Fort Collins waitlists are often long; ask about CCAP.
resources.address: 424 Pine St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Teaching Tree Early Childhood - Loveland
resources.description: Same sliding-scale nonprofit child care as the Fort Collins center, for infants through preschool in Loveland. Call for a tour and waitlist; CCAP often accepted.
resources.address: 2366 E 1st St, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Colorado Universal Preschool (UPK)
resources.description: Up to 15 hours a week of tuition-free preschool in the year before kindergarten for every Colorado child. Some kids qualify for more hours. Apply at upk.colorado.gov.

resources.name: Thompson Integrated Early Childhood (Head Start & UPK)
resources.description: Preschool for 3- and 4-year-olds who live in Thompson School District (Loveland, Berthoud). Mix of Head Start, Universal Preschool, Child Find classrooms, and limited tuition seats.
resources.address: 407 E 42nd St, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Fuerza Latina immigrant emergency hotline
resources.description: Spanish-language hotline for immigrant neighbors in Larimer County: know-your-rights, rapid response, and help finding a trusted attorney. Office line for jobs and advocacy is 970-235-0061.
resources.address: Fort Collins, CO
resources.hours: Call; leave a message if needed

resources.name: Immigrant & Refugee Center of Northern Colorado
resources.description: English classes, community navigation, interpretation, and help connecting to housing, health, and legal resources. Office is in Evans; they serve Northern Colorado including Larimer County.
resources.address: 3001 8th Ave, Suite 170, Evans, CO 80620
resources.hours: Mon 8am-5pm; Tue-Thu 8am-8pm with a midday close; Fri by appointment mornings

resources.name: Church World Service - Fort Collins
resources.description: Low- or no-cost immigration legal help (citizenship, green cards, work permits, TPS, family petitions) plus refugee case support. Appointments only; phone and virtual options for people outside town.
resources.address: 531 S College Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Alianza NORCO
resources.description: Pro bono and low-cost immigration legal services in Fort Collins, including deportation defense, DACA, U/T visas, TPS, and family petitions. Call or text.
resources.address: 2629 Redwing Rd, Suite 298, Fort Collins, CO 80526
resources.hours: Call or text for an appointment

resources.name: Catholic Charities immigration legal services
resources.description: Board of Immigration Appeals accredited help with family visas, citizenship, DACA, VAWA/U visas, and some deportation defense. People outside the Denver metro can consult by phone or video.

resources.name: Immigrant Hope - Greeley
resources.description: DOJ-accredited, low-cost help with citizenship, family petitions, green cards, DACA/TPS renewals, and work permits. Same building as IRC in Evans. No asylum or removal-defense cases.
resources.address: 3001 8th Ave, Suite 170, Evans, CO 80620
resources.hours: Mon-Wed 9am-5pm; last Sat of the month 8am-12pm; by appointment

resources.name: ISAAC of Northern Colorado
resources.description: Interfaith accompaniment, know-your-rights, and scholarships toward trusted immigration attorneys. Call the hotline to see if you qualify or to get a referral list.

resources.name: Colorado Immigrant Rights Coalition (CIRC)
resources.description: Statewide immigrant-rights network. 24/7 bilingual line to report ICE activity. Office (303-922-3344) can connect you with a Northern Colorado organizer and know-your-rights materials.

resources.name: SummitStone substance use & Longview detox
resources.description: Larimer County public substance-use treatment, including walk-in detox and crisis care at Longview Acute Care. Medicaid-friendly outpatient counseling. Same 24/7 number as their crisis line.
resources.address: 2260 W Trilby Rd, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: Harmony Recovery (Estes Park)
resources.description: Nonprofit residential detox and rehab in Estes Park. Takes many insurances; call to check cost. Not a free public clinic. Admissions are scheduled.
resources.address: 1600 Fish Hatchery Rd, Estes Park, CO 80517

resources.name: Turning Point Center for Youth & Family Development
resources.description: Outpatient substance-use and mental-health care, DUI/DWAI classes, teen intensive outpatient, and family coaching. Fort Collins and Greeley offices.
resources.address: 1644 S College Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80525

resources.name: Alcoholics Anonymous - Northern Colorado Intergroup
resources.description: Free 12-step meetings across Fort Collins, Loveland, Estes Park, and nearby towns. Central office sells literature and can point you to a meeting. Phone is answered 24/7 by volunteers.
resources.address: 155 N College Ave, Suite 120, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Narcotics Anonymous - Off the Wall Area
resources.description: Free NA meetings in Fort Collins, Loveland, Estes Park, Windsor, and Greeley. Helpline can find a meeting or let you talk with someone in recovery.
resources.hours: Helpline; meetings most days (check the list)

resources.name: SAMHSA National Helpline
resources.description: Free, confidential 24/7 treatment referral and information for substance use and mental health. English and Spanish. They can locate detox, rehab, and local programs.

resources.name: Health District Mental Health & Substance Use Connections
resources.description: Northern Larimer County navigators who help you find counseling, substance-use treatment, and how to pay for it. Not a crisis line (use 988 or SummitStone for that).
resources.address: 120 Bristlecone Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Al-Anon Family Groups (Colorado)
resources.description: Free meetings for family and friends of people with a drinking problem. Statewide line can find a Fort Collins or Loveland meeting. Separate from AA.

resources.name: Foothills Gateway
resources.description: Larimer County community-centered board: intake, case management, and supports for children and adults with intellectual or developmental disabilities. After-hours on-call uses the same number.
resources.address: 301 W Skyway Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80525

resources.name: Early Intervention Colorado
resources.description: Free evaluation and services for babies and toddlers (birth to 3) with developmental delays or qualifying diagnoses. Anyone can refer. Local services are arranged after the statewide intake.

resources.name: The Arc of Larimer County
resources.description: Advocacy, information, and support for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities and their families. Help navigating school, Medicaid, and adult services.
resources.address: 1721 W Harmony Rd, Unit 101, Fort Collins, CO 80526
resources.hours: Mon-Fri; ask for the main desk (ext. 0)

resources.name: Poudre School District Child Find
resources.description: Free developmental screening and special-education evaluation for children ages 3-5 in the Poudre district (Fort Collins, Wellington, Timnath, Laporte). Call if you are worried about speech, movement, or learning.
resources.address: 2407 Laporte Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Thompson School District Child Find
resources.description: Free Child Find screening for 3- to 5-year-olds in Loveland and Berthoud. Different number from the Head Start / preschool office. Ask for the Child Find coordinator.
resources.address: 407 E 42nd St, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Respite Care Inc.
resources.description: Short-term care for children and teens (6 weeks to 18) with developmental disabilities so families can rest. Now at Vista Del Pico in Timnath, not the old Lemay building. 24/7 care; office weekdays.
resources.address: 5000 Vista Del Pico Dr, Timnath, CO 80547

resources.name: Family Voices Colorado
resources.description: Statewide parent-to-parent help for families of children and youth with special health care needs. Navigation, insurance questions, and advocacy. English and Spanish.

resources.name: PEAK Parent Center
resources.description: Colorado's Parent Training and Information Center. Free advice on special education, IEPs, inclusion, and disability rights for families of kids birth through 26. English and Spanish.

resources.name: NoCo Santa Squad
resources.description: Christmas and birthday gifts for Northern Colorado kids. Santa Cops of Larimer County dissolved; this veteran- and first-responder group replaced it. Families apply through a school resource officer. Applications usually open in October.
resources.hours: Seasonal; apply in the fall through your school SRO

resources.name: Kenzi's Causes Toy Shop - Fort Collins
resources.description: Free toy shop for children birth through 18, usually the first Saturday in December at Northside Aztlan. First come, first served. Bring a birth certificate for each child. You may only attend one Kenzi shop per year. Check the site for this year's date.
resources.address: 112 E Willow St, Fort Collins, CO 80524
resources.hours: Typically early December; confirm on their site

resources.name: Salvation Army Angel Tree - Fort Collins
resources.description: Christmas gifts and holiday help for local children. Register in the fall; donors pick tags from Angel Trees around town. Same corps that runs the pantry on South Mason.
resources.address: 3901 S Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80525
resources.hours: Seasonal; call in the fall to register or donate

resources.name: Salvation Army Christmas assistance - Loveland
resources.description: Holiday food and toy help for Loveland and Berthoud families. Call the Loveland corps in the fall to ask when registration opens. Not the same as the Fort Collins Angel Tree.
resources.address: 840 N Lincoln Ave, Suite 101, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Toys for Tots (request a toy)
resources.description: Marine Toys for Tots holiday toys. Apply online when the request window opens each fall. Local drop-off sites change yearly; the national site lists them. No local phone.

resources.name: House of Neighborly Service holiday help
resources.description: Loveland holiday food boxes and seasonal gift help for people they already serve and others who apply. Sign-up is in the fall. Berthoud families can ask the Berthoud pantry (970-532-0161).
resources.address: 1511 E 11th St, Suite 100, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Crossroads Ministry of Estes Park holiday programs
resources.description: Holiday food and gift help for Estes Park and the surrounding mountain communities. Ask in the fall when registration opens. Same office as their year-round pantry.
resources.address: 1753 Wildfire Rd, Estes Park, CO 80517

resources.name: Health District Family Dental Clinic
resources.description: Low-cost and sliding-fee dentistry for northern Larimer County residents. Medicaid and CHP+ accepted; adult Medicaid dental has no annual cap here. New patients start with an eligibility visit. Same-day emergency slots when they have them.
resources.address: 202 Bristlecone Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Salud Family Health - Fort Collins dental
resources.description: Dental care at the Fort Collins community health center. Sliding-fee for uninsured patients; Medicaid, Medicare, and CHP+ accepted. Same Blue Spruce clinic as medical, different department.
resources.address: 1635 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Sunrise Community Health - Loveland dental
resources.description: Sliding-fee dental clinic (cleanings, fillings, extractions, dentures, kids dentistry) at South Loveland. Use this dental number, not the medical line. Medicaid and CHP+ accepted.
resources.address: 302 3rd St SE, Suite 150, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: KIND (Kids in Need of Dentistry)
resources.description: Discounted dental and orthodontic care for Colorado children through age 18 who are uninsured and income-eligible, plus kids on Medicaid or CHP+. Clinics are in the Denver metro, not Fort Collins. Apply first, then they schedule.

resources.name: Dental Lifeline Network Colorado (Donated Dental)
resources.description: Volunteer dentists who treat adults who are elderly, disabled, or medically fragile and cannot afford care. Larimer County uses the outside-Denver-metro coordinator. Waitlists are common. Apply online or by mail.

resources.name: CSU Health Network Dental Services
resources.description: Affordable dental care for enrolled Colorado State University students only. Not open to the public. Third floor of the Health and Medical Center.
resources.address: 151 W Lake St, Fort Collins, CO 80523
resources.hours: Weekdays; hours follow the student health calendar

resources.name: American Red Cross of Northern Colorado
resources.description: Shelter, food, and recovery help after home fires, floods, and wildfires. 24/7 disaster line. Local office is in Loveland. Also CPR and first-aid classes.
resources.address: 1808 N Boise Ave, Suite 110, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Larimer County emergency information line
resources.description: County Office of Emergency Management info line for active wildfires, evacuations, road closures, and animal sheltering. For life-threatening emergencies call 911. Sign up for alerts at nocoalert.org.
resources.hours: Staffed during incidents (often 8am-8pm); otherwise check the web

resources.name: Fort Collins Emergency Preparedness and Security
resources.description: City emergency management (FC Ready). Not 911. Help with preparedness, the city's emergency operations, and questions during a Fort Collins incident.
resources.address: 300 Laporte Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Loveland Office of Emergency Management
resources.description: City/fire emergency management for Loveland. Use for preparedness and non-911 questions during a local disaster. Evacuation alerts still come through NOCO Alert.

resources.name: FEMA Disaster Assistance
resources.description: Federal grants and loans after a presidential disaster declaration. Only open for listed events. Register online or by phone. An app disaster in Larimer does not always qualify.
resources.hours: Phone 24/7 when a registration period is open

resources.name: Disaster Distress Helpline
resources.description: 24/7 crisis counseling for stress after a wildfire, flood, or other disaster. Call or text. Separate from 988, which is still the right number for a mental-health emergency.

resources.name: NOCO Alert (emergency notifications)
resources.description: Free wireless alerts for evacuations, wildfires, and other emergencies in Larimer County. Sign up online. You can also text LCEVAC to 888777 for evacuation messages. This is not a phone helpline.
resources.hours: Alerts 24/7 once you are signed up

resources.name: Alexander Mountain Fire long-term recovery
resources.description: Disaster case management for people who had property damage from the Alexander Mountain Fire. Call even if you already applied elsewhere; they can still help with unmet needs.

resources.name: Colorado Division of Homeland Security & Emergency Management
resources.description: State emergency management. Use after a large disaster if local OEM and Red Cross cannot answer recovery questions, or to find your local emergency manager.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri business hours; 24/7 during statewide incidents

resources.name: ServSafe Food Handler
resources.description: The kitchen card restaurants actually know. About 90 minutes online, $15, English or Spanish. Valid 3 years. Helps you get hired or a raise at fast food, grocery, and cafe jobs. Ask the Larimer Workforce Center if they can cover the fee.

resources.name: OSHA 10-Hour card (construction or general industry)
resources.description: The safety card warehouses, construction, and manufacturing often want. Use OSHA's official trainer list only — fake 'OSHA certified' sites will not give you a real card. The course is not free; ask WIOA at the Workforce Center to pay. A forklift 'certificate' sold online is not OSHA training; your employer has to train you on the lift.

resources.name: Workforce Center paid job training (WIOA)
resources.description: If you are homeless, in recovery, on SNAP or TANF, or otherwise struggling to work, Larimer's Career Transition team can often pay for a real certificate: food handler or ServSafe Manager, OSHA-10, CNA, CDL, and similar. This is the same Workforce Center as the Jobs card — ask specifically for training money, not just resume help.
resources.address: 200 W Oak St, Suite 5000, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: CareerReady Colorado Certificate (WorkKeys)
resources.description: A skills certificate signed by the governor: applied math, workplace documents, and graphic literacy. Many employers treat it as proof you can handle a first job even without a long work history. Ask the Workforce Center (970-498-6600) to schedule it — do not pay a random website for a fake NCRC.
resources.address: 200 W Oak St, Suite 5000, Fort Collins, CO 80521
resources.hours: By appointment at a workforce center

resources.name: Colorado Shines PDIS (child-care credentials)
resources.description: Free state courses and an Early Childhood Professional Credential. Daycares and preschools hire people who have the required health-and-safety hours. Pair it with Colorado Mandatory Reporter training. Create an account through Colorado Shines, then take PDIS courses.

resources.name: Mental Health First Aid (Colorado classes)
resources.description: One-day certificate in spotting a mental-health or substance-use crisis and getting someone help. SummitStone often runs it free in Fort Collins. Useful for peer work, shelters, restaurants, and any job that deals with people in crisis. Search the Colorado class calendar — do not pay a random online knockoff.
resources.address: 4856 Innovation Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80525
resources.hours: Scheduled day-long classes; some are free

resources.name: Colorado Peer and Family Specialist (CPFS)
resources.description: State peer-recovery credential for people with lived experience of addiction or mental illness who want to get paid to walk with others. You need about 60 training hours, supervised peer hours, and usually two years in your own recovery. Application and exam run about $295; ask COPA about scholarships and ask SummitStone or the Health District about peer jobs.

resources.name: Colorado QMAP (medication administration)
resources.description: State qualification to give meds in assisted living, group homes, and some disability programs. Start with the free CDPHE prep course on CO.TRAIN, then take an approved class (often $90–$120 locally). Must be 18. Group homes and Foothills Gateway-type jobs ask for this.

resources.name: McDonald's Archways to Opportunity
resources.description: If you already work at a participating McDonald's: free high-school diploma, English classes, and college tuition help. Crew usually need 90 days and about 15 hours a week. Ask your GM — this is how a fast-food job turns into a raise or a diploma, not a public food-handler class.

resources.name: NWCG S-190 Introduction to Wildland Fire Behavior
resources.description: Free federal intro course used for seasonal wildland-fire and conservation-crew jobs. Take it on the Wildland Fire Learning Portal. An official firefighter card still needs S-130 plus a fire department or crew — this class alone is the usual first step, not a job offer.

resources.name: Transfort Dial-A-Ride (ADA paratransit)
resources.description: Door-to-door rides in Fort Collins for people whose disability keeps them from using regular Transfort buses. Apply first (up to 21 days). Book up to 14 days ahead. Dial-A-Taxi vouchers ($15) cover some trips Dial-A-Ride cannot. Visitors with ADA eligibility from another city can ride up to 21 days a year.
resources.address: 250 N Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Colorado Communications Technology Program (free phones)
resources.description: Free amplified or captioned phones, smartphones/tablets, ring signalers and related gear for qualified Deaf, hard-of-hearing, DeafBlind, or speech-disabled Coloradans. Apply through the state Commission. Disabled Resource Services in Fort Collins can help with the paperwork.

resources.name: Relay Colorado (711)
resources.description: Free 24/7 relay so people who are Deaf, hard of hearing, or have a speech disability can call anyone. Dial 711, or 1-800-659-2656. Spanish 1-800-337-3242. Works with TTY, captioned phones, and other devices.

resources.name: Colorado Talking Book Library
resources.description: Free audiobooks, braille and large-print books mailed to people who cannot read standard print because of a vision, physical, or reading disability. Players are loaned at no cost. Anyone can certify eligibility, including a librarian or doctor.
resources.address: 180 Sheridan Blvd, Denver, CO 80226

resources.name: Hearts & Horses Therapeutic Riding (Loveland)
resources.description: PATH Intl. therapeutic riding and unmounted horse programs for kids (4+) and adults with physical, cognitive, or emotional disabilities. Call for costs, scholarships, and a tour. Not a medical clinic.
resources.address: 163 N County Road 29, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Disability Law Colorado
resources.description: Statewide protection and advocacy: disability civil rights, special education, Medicaid, abuse/neglect in facilities, and the Client Assistance Program if you have a problem with DVR. Not a walk-in clinic; call or use the website intake.
resources.address: 1580 Logan St, 6th Floor, Denver, CO 80203

resources.name: Colorado Cross-Disability Coalition
resources.description: Disability-rights advocacy, especially Medicaid and housing access. Fill out the assistance form or leave a voicemail; they call back within three business days. Not an emergency line and not direct care.
resources.address: 1385 S Colorado Blvd, Suite 610-A, Denver, CO 80222
resources.hours: Leave a message; callback in 3 business days

resources.name: Colorado Assistive Technology Act Program
resources.description: Statewide help finding, trying, and funding assistive technology (devices that make daily tasks possible). Device loans and information through CU Denver's Center for Inclusive Design and Engineering. DRS in Fort Collins can also research equipment locally.
resources.address: 1224 5th St, Suite 130, Denver, CO 80204

resources.name: City of Fort Collins ADA Coordinator
resources.description: Request a reasonable accommodation for a city program, report an accessibility problem (including Transfort / Dial-A-Ride), or file an ADA complaint. Ask at least 48 hours before an event. Relay Colorado: 711.
resources.address: 300 Laporte Ave, Building A, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Disabled parking placard (Larimer Clerk)
resources.description: Colorado persons-with-disabilities parking placard or plates. A licensed medical provider completes form DR 2219; turn it in at Larimer County Vehicle Licensing (or by mail). Temporary and permanent placards available.
resources.address: 200 W Oak St, Fort Collins, CO 80521
resources.hours: Mon-Fri; call for Vehicle Licensing hours

resources.name: Medicaid Buy-In for Working Adults with Disabilities
resources.description: Health First Colorado coverage you can keep while you work if you have a disability. You pay a sliding premium based on income. Apply on Colorado PEAK or at Larimer County Human Services. Ask DRS if you need help with the application.
resources.address: 1501 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Home Care Allowance (HCA)
resources.description: Colorado cash to pay a home-care helper (bathing, dressing, meals, shopping) so you can stay in your own home. You need a functional assessment plus financial eligibility (SSI, AND-SO, or related). Start with Larimer Aging & Disability Resources or Foothills Gateway; apply through Human Services / PEAK.
resources.address: 1501 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Brain Injury Alliance of Colorado
resources.description: Free navigation, education and support after brain injury, stroke, or concussion. A Northern Colorado support group meets monthly (currently listed in Johnstown; confirm with the alliance). No official diagnosis required for most help.

resources.name: NAMI Larimer County
resources.description: Free support groups and classes for people living with mental illness and for families. Groups meet in Fort Collins and on Zoom. Email namilarimer@gmail.com or call the numbers on the website to get on the list. Not a crisis line (use 988).
resources.address: 2000 S Lemay Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80525

resources.name: Special Olympics Colorado
resources.description: Year-round sports for children and adults with intellectual disabilities. Northeast-region events include Northern Colorado. Fort Collins Adaptive Recreation (ARO) also connects local athletes. Ask about Unified Partner and volunteer roles.

resources.name: Rocky Mountain ADA Center
resources.description: Free, confidential answers about the Americans with Disabilities Act in Colorado: employment, government services, businesses, and how ADA overlaps with Fair Housing. Not an enforcement agency and not a lawyer.

resources.name: DAV Van to VA hospitals
resources.description: Free Disabled American Veterans van to Cheyenne and Denver VA Medical Centers. Book at least 48 hours ahead. Morning appointments are easier to serve. For veterans with a VA appointment.
resources.address: Fort Collins, CO

resources.name: Social Security Ticket to Work
resources.description: Free employment program for people 18-64 who receive SSI or SSDI and want to work. Connects you to Employment Networks and DVR. Working can affect benefits; ask DRS or DVR before you change hours. Helpline 1-866-968-7842.

resources.name: Colorado Housing Search (accessible units)
resources.description: Free statewide listing of apartments and homes, with filters for wheelchair-accessible and other accessible units. Call Colorado Housing Connects at 1-844-926-6632 if you need a navigator. Listings change; confirm accessibility with the landlord.

resources.name: Colorado ABLE savings account
resources.description: Tax-advantaged savings for people with disabilities that does not count against SSI or Medicaid the way a regular bank account can. Open at coloradoable.org. Customer service 1-888-609-3468 (Mon-Fri 8am-5pm MT).

resources.name: Health First Colorado HCBS waivers (in-home care)
resources.description: Extra Medicaid benefits so people with disabilities can stay at home instead of a nursing facility: personal care, home mods, adult day, and more. In Larimer, start with Aging & Disability Resources (adults) or Foothills Gateway (IDD). Some waivers have waitlists. Member Contact Center 1-800-221-3943.

resources.name: Medicare Extra Help (Part D low-income subsidy)
resources.description: Federal help paying Medicare prescription-drug costs if you have limited income. Many people on SSI or Medicaid are already enrolled. Apply through Social Security (1-800-772-1213) or medicare.gov. Not the same as Medicaid Buy-In.

resources.name: Loveland Adaptive Recreation
resources.description: City of Loveland recreation for people with physical, intellectual, or emotional disabilities: adaptive classes, inclusion support in regular programs, unified sports, and caregiver support passes. Call the Adaptive Recreation coordinator at Chilson Recreation Center. Ask at least two weeks before a class.
resources.address: 700 E 4th St, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Children's Speech & Reading Center
resources.description: Speech-language and reading therapy for kids in Fort Collins and Loveland. Sliding scale down to $0 so no child is turned away for cost. Free screenings. Offices at 1302 S Shields (FoCo) and 2366 E 1st St (Loveland).
resources.address: 1302 S Shields St, Units A1-3, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Parent to Parent of Colorado
resources.description: Free matching of parents of kids with disabilities or special health needs to a trained parent who has been there. English and Spanish. A program of Ability Connection Colorado. Not a crisis line.
resources.address: 801 Yosemite St, Denver, CO 80230

resources.name: Autism Society of Colorado
resources.description: Statewide information, navigation, and community for autistic people and families. Office hours by appointment. Not a crisis line (use 988) and not a diagnosis clinic.

resources.name: Colorado Center for the Blind
resources.description: Independence training, employment programs, summer youth programs, and Older Blind services. Based in Littleton; serves Coloradans statewide, including Northern Colorado referrals from DVR and Ensight.
resources.address: 2233 W Shepperd Ave, Littleton, CO 80120

resources.name: NFB-NEWSLINE Colorado (free newspapers by phone)
resources.description: Free 24/7 newspapers, magazines, and TV listings by phone, web, Alexa, or talking-book player for people who are blind, have low vision, or cannot read print. Enroll through the Colorado Center for the Blind (ask for NEWSLINE).

resources.name: Aftersight (audio news for print disabilities)
resources.description: Free audio newspapers, magazines, and local information for people who are blind, have low vision, or cannot read print. Formerly Audio Information Network of Colorado. Toll-free 1-877-443-2001.
resources.address: 1805 Hwy 42, Ste 220, Louisville, CO 80027

resources.name: Bookshare (free accessible ebooks)
resources.description: Free ebooks in audio, braille, and large print for U.S. students and adults with qualifying print disabilities (dyslexia, vision, or physical). Proof of disability required. Also works with the Colorado Talking Book Library.

resources.name: Easterseals Colorado - Northern Colorado (Loveland)
resources.description: Adult day program (Wings) and community activities for adults with developmental disabilities at the Loveland site. Statewide Easterseals Colorado also offers employment services. Main office 303-233-1666.
resources.address: 1327 Eisenhower Blvd, Loveland, CO 80537
resources.hours: Day program Mon-Fri; call for intake

resources.name: Poudre School District SWAP (school to work)
resources.description: Free School to Work Alliance Program with DVR for PSD youth and young adults with employment barriers: career counseling, work experiences, and job placement. Ages roughly 16-25. Office at 902 W Drake #5.
resources.address: 902 W Drake Rd #5, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: Thompson School District SWAP (school to work)
resources.description: Free School to Work Alliance Program with DVR for Thompson (Loveland/Berthoud) youth and young adults with disabilities: job exploration, placement, and follow-up. Call 970-669-8349.
resources.address: 427 N Railroad Ave, Suite B, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Job Accommodation Network (JAN)
resources.description: Free, confidential help figuring out workplace accommodations under the ADA: equipment, schedule changes, and how to ask your employer. Not a lawyer and not DVR. U.S. Department of Labor funded.

resources.name: Colorado Civil Rights Division (disability discrimination)
resources.description: Free state complaints for disability discrimination in jobs, housing, and public places. File online through CaseConnect or call. Deadlines are short — do not wait. Relay 711. Spanish 720-432-4294. Not the same as Disability Law Colorado.
resources.address: 1560 Broadway, Suite 825, Denver, CO 80202
resources.hours: Mon-Fri; intake by phone or CaseConnect

resources.name: ADA Information Line (U.S. Department of Justice)
resources.description: Free answers about the Americans with Disabilities Act: businesses, state and local government, and how to file a federal complaint. Not legal representation. Spanish available.

resources.name: HUD housing discrimination complaint (disability)
resources.description: File a federal Fair Housing complaint if a landlord, HOA, or housing authority refuses a reasonable accommodation or accessible unit because of disability. Free. Also try Colorado Civil Rights Division and Colorado Housing Connects (1-844-926-6632).

resources.name: CSU Student Disability Center
resources.description: Academic accommodations for Colorado State University students with disabilities (exams, housing, access). Appointments in TILT room 121, phone, or Teams. Not a community clinic — you must be a CSU student. Email sdc_csu@colostate.edu.
resources.address: TILT Room 121, Fort Collins, CO 80523
resources.hours: By appointment; drop-in hours on website

resources.name: Front Range Community College Disability Support Services
resources.description: Accommodations for FRCC students with a disability, diagnosis, or medical condition at the Larimer campus (Mount Antero 350) and other campuses. Email FRCC.DSS@frontrange.edu or call the DSS appointment line.
resources.address: 4616 S Shields St, Mount Antero Suite 350, Fort Collins, CO 80526
resources.hours: Mon-Fri; see DSS hours on website

resources.name: CSU RAM Scholars (inclusive college)
resources.description: Inclusive higher-education pathway at Colorado State University for adults with intellectual or developmental disabilities. Career and campus life with supports. Apply through RAM Scholars, not regular CSU admissions. Email ramscholars@colostate.edu.
resources.address: Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO 80523
resources.hours: Call or email for application windows

resources.name: CSU Center for Community Partnerships
resources.description: Job coaching and job development for people with disabilities in Northern Colorado, plus campus programs (OPS, Thrive, Belong housing for neurodiverse young adults). Alder Hall 201. Email contactccp@colostate.edu.
resources.address: 850 S Mason St, Alder Hall 201, Fort Collins, CO 80523

resources.name: IN! Pathways to Inclusive Higher Education
resources.description: Statewide advocacy for college options for students with intellectual disability (including CSU RAM Scholars). IN! does not enroll students directly — they explain the pathways. Free webinars and modules on the website.
resources.hours: Call or use the website contact form

resources.name: FAFSA (federal student aid)
resources.description: Free Application for Federal Student Aid. One form for Pell Grants, work-study, and student loans at CSU, Front Range, Aims, and other colleges. Apply at studentaid.gov. Help line in English and Spanish.
resources.hours: Phone hours on studentaid.gov; apply online 24/7

resources.name: College Opportunity Fund (COF stipend)
resources.description: Colorado stipend that pays part of in-state undergraduate tuition at public colleges, including CSU and Front Range. Create a COF account, then authorize it when you register for classes. Without it, tuition is billed at the full rate.

resources.name: Colorado Opportunity Scholarship Initiative (COSI)
resources.description: State scholarships and support programs for Colorado students heading to college or finishing a credential. Ask financial aid at Front Range, Aims, or CSU, or start at the Colorado Department of Higher Education.

resources.name: CSU Rams Against Hunger (campus pantry)
resources.description: On-campus food pantry, meal swipes, and SNAP help for CSU students, staff, and faculty. Bring a CSU ID and bags. General Services Building, 1251 Mason Street. Hours change by semester — check the website.
resources.address: 1251 Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80521
resources.hours: Check current hours on the Basic Needs website

resources.name: CSU Student Case Management
resources.description: Help for enrolled CSU students navigating a crisis, illness, housing, food, SNAP, or campus processes. Appointments in person or on Teams. Email help4rams@colostate.edu.
resources.address: 501 W Lake St, Suite B, Fort Collins, CO 80523

resources.name: CSU Health Network
resources.description: Medical care, counseling, pharmacy, and related services for enrolled Colorado State University students. Health and Medical Center at College and Prospect. Not open to the public except the pharmacy.
resources.address: 151 W Lake St, Fort Collins, CO 80523
resources.hours: Mon, Wed-Fri 8am-5pm; Tue 10am-5pm (hours follow the student calendar)

resources.name: CSU Student Legal Services
resources.description: Legal advice for enrolled CSU students who have paid the student fee: leases, deposits, tickets, employment, and other civil issues. Not for non-students. Lory Student Center 274.
resources.address: Lory Student Center 274, Fort Collins, CO 80523

resources.name: CSU Off-Campus Life
resources.description: Rental listings, roommate help, and tenant information for CSU students living off campus. Lory Student Center 281. Email ocl@colostate.edu.
resources.address: Lory Student Center 281, Fort Collins, CO 80523

resources.name: CSU Career Center
resources.description: Resumes, Handshake jobs, internships, and drop-in career help for CSU students and recent alumni. Lower level of the Lory Student Center, room 120.
resources.address: Lory Student Center 120, Fort Collins, CO 80523
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 9am-4:30pm; drop-in hours on the website

resources.name: CSU Office of Financial Aid
resources.description: Pell Grants, work-study, loans, scholarships, and the College Opportunity Fund for Colorado State University students. Centennial Hall. Bring questions about FAFSA and billing.
resources.address: Centennial Hall, Fort Collins, CO 80523

resources.name: FRCC WOLF Pantry (Larimer Campus)
resources.description: Free food and essentials for enrolled Front Range Community College students, faculty, and staff. Longs Peak Student Center. Register in PantrySoft before the first visit. About once a week.
resources.address: 4616 S Shields St, Longs Peak Student Center, Fort Collins, CO 80526
resources.hours: Mon-Thu during campus hours; closed campus breaks

resources.name: Front Range Community College Financial Aid (Larimer)
resources.description: FAFSA help, grants, work-study, and scholarships for Front Range students at the Larimer campus. Appointments on campus or remote.
resources.address: 4616 S Shields St, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: FRCC Larimer Testing Center (GED and HiSET)
resources.description: Take the GED or HiSET high-school equivalency exams at Front Range Community College's Larimer Testing Center. Schedule the GED at GED.com first; the center cannot book it for you. Colorado residents 17 and older (16 with a waiver).
resources.address: 4616 S Shields St, Fort Collins, CO 80526
resources.hours: Testing center hours on the FRCC website

resources.name: Aims Community College - Loveland Campus
resources.description: Community college classes, certificates, and advising in downtown Loveland. Financial aid and GED testing options through Aims. Small campus; call for advising hours.
resources.address: 104 E 4th St, Loveland, CO 80537
resources.hours: Call for campus and advising hours

resources.name: Poudre School District McKinney-Vento
resources.description: School enrollment, transportation, and supplies for PSD students (birth to 21) who do not have a fixed, regular place to sleep. Ask any school or email mckinneyteam@psdschools.org.
resources.address: 2407 LaPorte Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Thompson School District McKinney-Vento
resources.description: School enrollment and support for Thompson students in Loveland and Berthoud who lack stable housing. Ask the school or call the district liaison.
resources.address: 800 S Taft Ave, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Estes Park School District McKinney-Vento
resources.description: School support for Estes Park students who lack a stable place to stay. Ask the school counselor or the district social worker / homeless liaison.
resources.address: 1605 Brodie Ave, Estes Park, CO 80517

resources.name: Poudre School District school meals
resources.description: Breakfast and lunch at PSD schools. Most students receive no-cost meals; households should still submit the annual free/reduced application for funding, Summer EBT, and other benefits. Apply at myschoolapps.com or ask Child Nutrition.
resources.address: 1502 S Timberline Rd, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Larimer County
resources.description: After-school and summer programs for ages 6-18, with meals, homework help, and recreation. Fort Collins Club 970-484-5198; Loveland Pulliam 970-663-5450; Wellington 970-568-7338; Estes Park 970-817-4943. Membership fees are low; ask about scholarships.
resources.address: 1608 Lancer Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80521
resources.hours: School days typically 2:30-6:30pm; summer hours vary by club

resources.name: Poudre River Public Library District
resources.description: Free library cards for Larimer County residents: computers, Wi-Fi, printing, homework help, and online tutors. Old Town Library is at 201 Peterson Street. Also Harmony and Council Tree branches.
resources.address: 201 Peterson St, Fort Collins, CO 80524
resources.hours: See branch hours on the website

resources.name: Loveland Public Library
resources.description: Free library card for Loveland-area residents: computers, Wi-Fi, study space, and homework resources. 300 N Adams Avenue.
resources.address: 300 N Adams Ave, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: CASFA (Colorado Application for State Financial Aid)
resources.description: State aid application for students who cannot file a FAFSA, including undocumented students and mixed-status families. Use it for Colorado grants at CSU, Front Range, Aims, and other public colleges. For account problems email CASFA@dhe.state.co.us. Ask the college financial aid office about your award.

resources.name: Colorado ASSET (in-state tuition)
resources.description: In-state tuition at Colorado public colleges for students who attended a Colorado high school for at least one year (or completed a Colorado GED/HiSET) and lived in Colorado for the 12 months before college. Complete the COF affidavit and ask admissions at Front Range, Aims, or CSU. Pair with CASFA for state aid.

resources.name: CSU Access Center (TRIO college prep)
resources.description: Free college advising, tutoring, and FAFSA help for first-generation and income-eligible students in grades 6-12 and for adults heading back to school. Student Services Building 304. You do not have to be a CSU student to ask about Access Center programs.
resources.address: Student Services Building 304, Fort Collins, CO 80523

resources.name: CSU Academic Advancement Center (TRIO SSS)
resources.description: Advising, tutoring, and community for enrolled CSU students who are first-generation, income-eligible, or have a disability. L.L. Gibbons Building room 117. Email aac_sss@colostate.edu.
resources.address: 850 Oval Dr, Gibbons 117, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: CSU Educational Opportunity Center (Larimer)
resources.description: Free help for adults in Larimer County who want to finish a GED, apply to college, or file FAFSA or CASFA. You do not have to be a CSU student. Paul B. Thayer TRIO House, 1405 S College Avenue.
resources.address: 1405 S College Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: CSU Adult Learner and Veteran Services
resources.description: Drop-in space and advising for CSU student parents, veterans, transfers, and other adult learners. Lory Student Center 282.
resources.address: Lory Student Center 282, Fort Collins, CO 80523

resources.name: Colorado SUN Bucks (Summer EBT)
resources.description: Grocery money for school-age kids when school meals stop for summer. Most eligible students are enrolled automatically. Check status at cdhs.colorado.gov/summer-ebt. Support line: press option 8. Card PIN and balance: 1-888-328-2656.
resources.hours: Seasonal; see CDHS for the current application window

resources.name: Thompson School District school meals
resources.description: Breakfast and lunch at Thompson schools in Loveland and Berthoud. Colorado's Healthy School Meals for All program covers student meals; still submit the annual free/reduced application for fee waivers and Summer EBT. Apply at linqconnect.com.
resources.address: 800 S Taft Ave, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: CSU RamRide
resources.description: Free safe rides for CSU students and employees on Friday and Saturday nights during the school year, about 10pm-2:30am in Fort Collins. Call or use the RamRide app. Office shares Off-Campus Life in Lory Student Center 281.
resources.address: Lory Student Center 281, Fort Collins, CO 80523
resources.hours: Night rides Fri-Sat during the academic year; office Mon-Fri 9am-5pm

resources.name: FRCC Mental Health Counseling (Larimer)
resources.description: Short-term counseling for enrolled Front Range students. Larimer desk in Mount Antero 200. Email MHCounseling@frontrange.edu. After hours call 988.
resources.address: 4616 S Shields St, Mount Antero 200, Fort Collins, CO 80526
resources.hours: Campus hours; call to request a session

resources.name: FRCC Academic Success Center (Larimer tutoring)
resources.description: Free tutoring, writing and math help, and study space for Front Range students. Mount Antero 350. Email frcclcasc@frontrange.edu.
resources.address: 4616 S Shields St, Mount Antero 350, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: Estes Valley Library
resources.description: Free library card for Estes Park-area residents: computers, Wi-Fi, homework help, and study space. 335 E Elkhorn Avenue.
resources.address: 335 E Elkhorn Ave, Estes Park, CO 80517

resources.name: Outreach Fort Collins
resources.description: Street outreach team that finds people who are unhoused downtown, midtown, and north Fort Collins and helps them get to shelter, the Murphy Center, and other help. Call if you need a worker to come to you. Not 911.
resources.address: 19 Old Town Square, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Northern Colorado Coordinated Entry (CAHPS)
