resources.description: The housing waitlist for Larimer and Weld County homeless programs. Ask at the Murphy Center for an intake and coordinated assessment, or tell any shelter or outreach worker you want Coordinated Entry. Call 2-1-1 if you are not sure where to start.
resources.hours: Ask a navigator during agency hours

resources.name: Murphy Center Gear Room
resources.description: Sleeping bags, tents, coats, and other outdoor gear for people using the Murphy Center. Sign up at the front desk between 8am and 9:30am; pickup is 9:30-11:30am weekdays. You need a current Murphy Center intake.
resources.address: 242 Conifer St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: SummitStone clinic at the Murphy Center
resources.description: Walk-up mental health, substance-use, and basic medical care for people who are homeless or at risk of it, at the Murphy Center. No insurance required. Check in at the front desk or call the clinic line.
resources.address: 242 Conifer St, Fort Collins, CO 80524
resources.hours: Weekdays during Murphy Center hours; ask the front desk

resources.name: The Matthews House - The Landing (Loveland)
resources.description: 24/7 overnight and day shelter for youth ages 15-20 who do not have a safe place to stay. Meals, basic needs, and help finding longer-term housing. Call before you go if you can.
resources.address: 814 E 16th St, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: The Matthews House - Fort Collins drop-in
resources.description: Day drop-in for youth who need a safe place, food, and help connecting to The Landing or other housing. Mondays and Wednesdays. Under 18: staff will help you find the right next step.
resources.address: 415 Mason Ct #1, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Homeward Alliance housing navigation
resources.description: Help using a housing voucher, staying housed after a lease warning, and getting on Coordinated Entry. Does not hand out apartments or overnight beds. Start with a Resource Navigator at the Murphy Center, or call the housing line if you already have a voucher.
resources.address: 242 Conifer St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Larimer County Vital Records - birth certificates
resources.description: Certified Colorado birth certificates (1900-present). Fort Collins is the only vital-records office in Larimer County; Loveland and Estes Park do not issue them. In-person visits are by appointment. Bring photo ID. Spanish: same number.
resources.address: 1525 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Colorado DMV - Fort Collins (driver license and ID)
resources.description: State driver-license office for a new or replacement Colorado ID or license, written tests, and reinstatement. This is not the county vehicle-registration desk on Oak Street. If you have no home address, bring a letter from an agency that will accept your mail (Murphy Center can write that).
resources.address: 3030 S College Ave, Suite 100, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: Colorado DMV - Loveland (driver license and ID)
resources.description: State driver-license office for a new or replacement Colorado ID or license, written tests, and reinstatement. Not the county vehicle-licensing office. Same statewide DMV phone as Fort Collins.
resources.address: 118 E 29th St, Suite F, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Colorado Necessary Documents Program (ID vouchers)
resources.description: State program that can waive the fee for a Colorado ID, driver license, or birth certificate if you are homeless, low-income, 60+, disabled, a disaster survivor, or a survivor of domestic violence. Vouchers are handed out by Metro Caring (Denver) and partner sites. Ask at the Murphy Center or call 2-1-1 for a closer partner. Metro Caring walk-in ID vouchers are Tuesdays. Not for reinstatement fees.
resources.address: 1100 E 18th Ave, Denver, CO 80218
resources.hours: ID vouchers Tue during Fresh Foods Market hours; birth-certificate vouchers Mon-Thu

resources.name: Replace a Social Security card
resources.description: Request a replacement Social Security card online at ssa.gov if you can, or call for an appointment at the Fort Collins office. Bring original ID. Appointments are strongly recommended. National line 1-800-772-1213.
resources.address: 301 S Howes St, 4th Floor, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: myColorado app (digital ID)
resources.description: Official State of Colorado app. If you already have a Colorado driver license or ID, you can add a Digital ID for in-state proof of identity. It does not replace a physical card at every desk. Download only from the App Store or Google Play.

resources.name: Larimer County Clerk - passports
resources.description: Passport acceptance office. Staff take the application and photos. Appointments required; up to 3 applications per appointment. This is not a Colorado ID. Press 1 for a recording technician.
resources.address: 200 W Oak St, First Floor, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Murphy Center - DMV mail letter
resources.description: If you have no home address, the Colorado DMV needs a letter on agency letterhead saying the agency will accept your mail. Ask at the Murphy Center front desk for that letter, then go to the College Ave DMV. Navigators can also help with ID questions during day hours.
resources.address: 242 Conifer St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Animal Friends Alliance - Kibble Supply pantry
resources.description: Drive-thru dog and cat food for people who need help keeping a pet. First visit can be without an application; apply after that. First Sunday and third Monday each month, 9am-12pm. Come once a month. SNAP or Medicaid usually qualifies. Call ext. 5133 for the application.
resources.address: 2321 E Mulberry St, Unit 12A, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: 4 Paws Pet Pantry
resources.description: Pet food for people who bring recent proof of help such as SNAP, Medicaid, a Murphy Center or Crossroads referral, or a disability placard. Inside Spa 4 Paws on the south side of the Rollerland parking lot. If you do not qualify, a small donation can still get a bag of food.
resources.address: 328 S Link Ln #2B, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Colorado Pet Pantry - Food Bank Loveland
resources.description: Pet food distribution at the Food Bank for Larimer County in Loveland. Fourth Saturday of most months, 9-11am, outdoors. You can use Colorado Pet Pantry once every three months at any of their sites. Register through their site if asked.
resources.address: 2600 N Lincoln Ave, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Animal Friends Alliance PAL+ clinic
resources.description: Low-cost spay/neuter, core vaccines, and microchips for qualifying low-income households. PAL+ clients often pay about $35 per cat and $60 per dog for surgery. By appointment at the Mulberry clinic. Public clinic pricing is also posted if you do not qualify for PAL+.
resources.address: 2321 E Mulberry St, Unit 3, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Northern Colorado Equality
resources.description: Local LGBTQ+ nonprofit for events, Pride, advocacy, and connections in Larimer County. Not a drop-in shelter. Call or email for the next event and who else can help.
resources.hours: Call or email; no public walk-in desk

resources.name: PFLAG Fort Collins
resources.description: Support groups for LGBTQ+ people and their families. Fort Collins meets the second Monday at 6:30pm (Foxtail 2 at the Senior Center or a confidential room — email first). Also Loveland (fourth Monday), Estes Park (second Wednesday), and Longmont.
resources.address: 1200 Raintree Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80526
resources.hours: Fort Collins: second Monday 6:30-8pm; email for the room

resources.name: VOA Rainbow Respite (LGBTQ+ older adults)
resources.description: Free weekly in-home visits for LGBTQ+ older adults and a break for their caregivers. Volunteers of America Caring Companions. Not overnight care and not a drop-in center. Ask for Rainbow Respite or Caring Companions.
resources.address: 405 Canyon Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80521
resources.hours: Call weekdays to be matched with a volunteer

resources.name: CSU Pride Resource Center
resources.description: Walk-in space for CSU students and community members: staff, referrals, and a place to sit. Lory Student Center Room 232, near Sweet Sinsations. No appointment needed.
resources.address: Lory Student Center Room 232, Fort Collins, CO 80523

resources.name: The Trevor Project
resources.description: 24/7 crisis line for LGBTQ+ young people. Call, text START to 678-678, or chat on the website. Not a local walk-in. If someone is in immediate danger, call 911.

resources.name: The Center on Colfax (LGBTQ Colorado)
resources.description: Statewide LGBTQ+ community center in Denver: health referrals, support, and advocacy. About an hour south on I-25 if you need a dedicated center. Call before you go.
resources.address: 1301 E Colfax Ave, Denver, CO 80218

resources.name: 2-1-1 - today's warming or cooling center
resources.description: Warming and cooling sites change with the weather. Call 2-1-1 or text your ZIP to 898-211 and ask what is open today. Libraries, senior centers, and the Murphy Center are the usual indoor places when no extra site is listed.

resources.name: Murphy Center - heat and cold days
resources.description: Day shelter stays open on inclement-weather days, including holidays. Extreme heat: they may stay open until 7:30pm with AC, water, food, and restrooms. Winter: propane heaters on the west side when wind allows. Not overnight beds.
resources.address: 242 Conifer St, Fort Collins, CO 80524
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 8am-5pm; extra evening hours when they call an IWD

resources.name: Poudre Libraries - indoor heat and AC
resources.description: Free air-conditioned and heated public buildings: Old Town (201 Peterson), Harmony (4616 S Shields), and Council Tree (2733 Council Tree Ave). Sit, use restrooms and water, no purchase needed. Not an overnight shelter.
resources.address: 201 Peterson St, Fort Collins, CO 80524
resources.hours: Most branches Mon-Thu 9am-8pm; Fri 9am-6pm; Sat 9am-5pm; Sun 12-5pm

resources.name: Loveland Public Library - indoor heat and AC
resources.description: Public library with heat, AC, restrooms, and water. A reliable indoor place on hot or cold days when no extra cooling center is posted. Not overnight.
resources.address: 300 N Adams Ave, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Estes Valley Library - indoor heat and AC
resources.description: Public library with heat, AC, restrooms, and a place to sit during extreme weather in Estes Park.
resources.address: 335 E Elkhorn Ave, Estes Park, CO 80517

resources.name: Fort Collins Senior Center - indoor heat and AC
resources.description: Climate-controlled building for adults 50+. Drop in during regular hours on heat or cold days. Accessible. Not a designated overnight warming shelter.
resources.address: 1200 Raintree Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: Chilson Senior Center - indoor heat and AC
resources.description: Loveland recreation center for adults 50+ with heat and AC during posted hours. Call before you go on a holiday.
resources.address: 700 E 4th St, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Salvation Army Loveland - cool off and water
resources.description: Daytime place in Loveland to cool off, hydrate, and sit. Not overnight beds. Call for hours the day you need it.
resources.address: 840 N Lincoln Ave, Suite 101, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Homeward Alliance WAGEES reentry
resources.description: Wraparound help if you are on parole or were released from prison in the last 12 months and live in Larimer or Jackson County, age 18+. Case management, jobs, ID fees, work clothes, bus help, and sometimes first-month rent. Call the reentry line.
resources.address: 242 Conifer St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Seal a criminal record (Larimer courts)
resources.description: Court Resource Center staff can point you to the sealing forms. They cannot give legal advice. Many eligible cases are sealed automatically; if yours was not, file in the court that heard the case. Fee waivers use JDF 205. Colorado Legal Services (970-493-2891) may take the case if you qualify.
resources.address: 201 Laporte Ave, 1st Floor, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Workforce Center - jobs after incarceration
resources.description: Same Workforce Center as the Jobs tile. Ask for a career advisor and WIOA training money. Tell them you have a record so they can point you to employers who hire and to certificates the center can pay for. Computers and printers on site.
resources.address: 200 W Oak St, Suite 5000, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Connecting Colorado - job board
resources.description: State job board used by the Workforce Center. Create a profile and search openings. Required if you are on unemployment. Does not hide a record; it is where the jobs are posted.

resources.name: Habitat ReStore - Fort Collins
resources.description: Used furniture, appliances, building supplies, and household goods at thrift prices. This ReStore is scheduled to close on or before December 1, 2026; shop Loveland after that. Not a free giveaway.
resources.address: 4001 S Taft Hill Rd, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: Habitat ReStore - Loveland
resources.description: Used furniture, appliances, and household goods at thrift prices. Stays open after the Fort Collins ReStore closes. Not a free furniture bank; prices are low. Free donation pickup in FoCo, Loveland, Windsor, and Johnstown.
resources.address: 5250 N Garfield Ave, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: People Helping People — furniture (Suzanne Barslund)
resources.description: Ask for Suzanne (Suze) Barslund. They pick up gently used furniture and household goods and give them away at no charge — including to people moving from homelessness into housing, older adults, and single parents. Call if you need furniture, have something to donate, or can volunteer to lift, repair, organize, or deliver. Work days have been at Catch All Mini Storage in Loveland. Call first; this is not a walk-in store.
resources.address: 750 14th St SE, Loveland, CO 80537
resources.hours: Call Suzanne first. Volunteer work days have been Saturday mornings when a group is scheduled.

resources.name: Goodwill - Fort Collins
resources.description: Used furniture, dishes, clothes, and household goods. Regular thrift prices, long hours. Not a voucher program; bring cash or a card.
resources.address: 315 Pavilion Ln, Fort Collins, CO 80525

resources.name: Goodwill - Loveland
resources.description: Used furniture, dishes, clothes, and household goods on Eisenhower. Regular thrift prices.
resources.address: 935 E Eisenhower Blvd, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Arc Thrift Stores - Fort Collins
resources.description: Used furniture, household goods, and clothes. Sales support The Arc of Colorado. Regular thrift prices, open late most nights.
resources.address: 2701 S College Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80525

resources.name: Until They're Home - keep or rehome a pet
resources.description: Fort Collins rescue that helps you keep a pet instead of surrendering, or rehome it home-to-home. Temporary foster if you lose housing, go into the hospital, or are leaving abuse — you need a caseworker (ask at the Murphy Center, Crossroads, or 2-1-1). Not a walk-in kennel. Call or apply on the website.
resources.hours: Call or apply online; they email back within about 48 hours

resources.name: Animal Friends Alliance - Taft Hill adoption center
resources.description: Walk-in adoption center for dogs and cats (Jason Telleen Adoption Center). Fill out an adoption questionnaire online or at the desk. Adoptions stop 30 minutes before close. They will take a pet back if you cannot keep it. Lost pets usually go to NOCO Humane in Loveland, not here.
resources.address: 2200 N Taft Hill Rd, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: NOCO Humane Larimer Campus - lost pets and adoptions
resources.description: County shelter for lost and found dogs and cats in Fort Collins, Loveland, and unincorporated Larimer. Come in person to look; photos online are not enough. Bring proof you own the pet. Impound and boarding fees apply. Also adoptions and Larimer pet licenses. Formerly Larimer Humane Society.
resources.address: 3501 E 71st St, Loveland, CO 80538
resources.hours: Intake daily 9am-6pm weekdays, 9am-5pm weekends; adoptions afternoon hours — call the front desk

resources.name: NOCO Humane Animal Protection - stray and field calls
resources.description: Officers for Fort Collins, Loveland, and unincorporated Larimer: stray or loose animals, bite reports, and dead animals on public roads. Ask for extension 7. Not 911 unless a person is in danger. If you found a licensed pet, they can look up the owner.
resources.address: 3501 E 71st St, Loveland, CO 80538
resources.hours: Field: weekdays 8am-8pm, weekends 8am-6pm; after hours leave a message by priority

resources.name: CSU Veterinary Teaching Hospital - 24/7 emergency
resources.description: 24/7 small-animal emergency room for dogs, cats, and other pets. Call ahead so they can prepare. This is a hospital, not a free clinic — there is an exam fee, then they give an estimate. For low-cost vaccines or spay/neuter when it is not an emergency, use Animal Friends PAL+ instead.
resources.address: 300 W Drake Rd, Fort Collins, CO 80523
resources.hours: Emergency 24/7 including holidays; call the triage line first

resources.name: Animal Friends Alliance - community cats (TNR)
resources.description: Trap-neuter-return help for stray and feral cats. Email petresources@savinganimalstoday.org for a colony. If you cannot email, call ext. 5133. You can rent a humane trap at the Mulberry clinic or the Taft Hill center. Make an appointment before you trap.
resources.address: 2321 E Mulberry St, Unit 3, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Northern Colorado Friends of Ferals (TNR)
resources.description: Volunteer TNR for feral cat colonies in Northern Colorado. Call Leslie to get on a Saturday trapping list or to borrow traps. Clinic is appointment-only on clinic days; they do not have a shelter for cats to stay. About $40 per feral cat if you can pay; ask first if you cannot.
resources.address: 516 N Link Ln, Fort Collins, CO 80524
resources.hours: Call to schedule; trapping is usually Saturday, clinic Sunday

resources.name: Pet Association of Estes Park
resources.description: Local humane group for Estes Park and nearby mountain towns. Foster-based — no public kennel. Call about adoptions, stray help, and the fall spay/neuter clinic. For a loose dog or cat inside town, also call Estes police dispatch (not 911).
resources.hours: Call or email; no public walk-in shelter

resources.name: Estes Park animal control (police dispatch)
resources.description: Town animal-control desk for loose or found pets inside Estes Park. Call police dispatch, not 911, unless a person is in danger. Outside town limits, call NOCO Humane (970-226-3647). Wildlife is Colorado Parks and Wildlife, not this line.
resources.address: 170 MacGregor Ave, Estes Park, CO 80517
resources.hours: Dispatch 24/7; animal calls are not 911 unless someone is hurt

resources.name: Transfort trip planner (BusTime)
resources.description: Official Transfort planner: enter where you are and where you need to go, then tap Plan your trip. Shows which buses to take and when they arrive. Needs a signal. For a printed map, use Transfort route maps. Customer desk 970-221-6620.
resources.address: 250 N Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80524
resources.hours: Website 24/7; customer desk weekdays; buses Mon-Sat, no Sunday service

resources.name: Transfort route maps and schedules
resources.description: Every Fort Collins route with a map and timetable (MAX, FLEX, Gold, Horn, numbered routes). Open a route, or download the all-routes PDF to save on your phone for when you have no data. Routes changed Aug 17, 2026. No Sunday service.
resources.address: 250 N Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: FLEX bus (Fort Collins to Boulder)
resources.description: Regional Transfort bus: Fort Collins, Loveland, Berthoud, Longmont, and Boulder. Connects to COLT in Loveland and RTD in Longmont and Boulder. Currently fare-free on Transfort. Check the FLEX page for stop closures (College & Trilby, 287 & 65th).
resources.address: 250 N Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80524
resources.hours: Weekdays and Saturdays; no Sunday service; check holiday exceptions

resources.name: MAX (Mason corridor bus)
resources.description: Transfort's frequent Mason Street line from the South Transit Center through CSU and Midtown to Downtown Transit Center (250 N Mason). Fare-free. No Sunday service. Use the trip planner or Ride Transfort app for the next bus.
resources.address: 250 N Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Ride Transfort app (bus tracker)
resources.description: City of Fort Collins app: plan a bus trip, save a stop, and see the next arrival. Needs data or Wi-Fi. At a stop you can also text 41411 with TFORT and the stop number on the sign. Android: Play Store listing named Ride Transfort.
resources.hours: App when you have a signal; buses Mon-Sat

resources.name: Download Fort Collins in Google Maps
resources.description: This app cannot ship Google's map. Use the Offline maps card on Resources home, or open Google Maps, search your town, tap the name, then Download. Walking and driving can work with no signal. Bus and live traffic need data. Get directions in this app still hands off to Maps.
resources.hours: Anytime in the Google Maps app

resources.name: SAVA Center (sexual assault advocacy)
resources.description: 24-hour line for anyone affected by sexual violence in Larimer County. Advocates can meet you at the hospital, the police station, or the Fort Collins office. Therapy is sliding-scale; advocacy is free. Ask for an advocate when you call.
resources.address: 4812 S College Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80525

resources.name: Colorado Child Abuse & Neglect Hotline
resources.description: Call if you are worried a child in Larimer County is being hurt or left without care. The statewide line routes you to Larimer Children, Youth & Family. If the child is in immediate danger, call 911 first.

resources.name: Colorado Poison Center
resources.description: Free 24-hour line if someone swallowed medicine, cleaner, plants, or was bitten. Nurses and pharmacists tell you what to do at home versus the ER. Call 911 first if they cannot breathe.

resources.name: Fort Collins Police - Victim Services
resources.description: If you were the victim of a crime in Fort Collins, this desk can sit with you after the report, explain the case, and help with victim compensation paperwork. For an emergency call 911. Non-emergency police is 970-419-3273.
resources.address: 2221 S Timberline Rd, Fort Collins, CO 80525
resources.hours: Advocates on call 24/7; office during business hours

resources.name: Larimer County Adult Protective Services
resources.description: Call to report abuse, neglect, or financial exploitation of an older adult or an adult with a disability who cannot protect themselves. You can stay anonymous. If they are in immediate danger, call 911.
resources.address: 1501 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524
resources.hours: Intake 24/7; after hours emergencies still call 911

resources.name: Salvation Army Care Closet - Fort Collins
resources.description: Free clothing and personal items. Shop when volunteers are on the floor — call ahead so you are not turned away. Same South Mason building as the pantry. Closed 12-12:30pm on days they are open.
resources.address: 3901 S Mason St, Fort Collins, CO 80525
resources.hours: Mon, Wed, Thu 10am-2pm (closed 12-12:30pm); Fri 10am-noon. Call ahead.

resources.name: House of Neighborly Service - clothing (Loveland)
resources.description: Free clothing, shoes, bedding, and small household items after you meet a Resource Navigator. Come early; last sign-in is 30 minutes before close. Separate from Treasure Exchange, which is the paid thrift shop in the same building.
resources.address: 1511 E 11th St, Suite 100, Loveland, CO 80537
resources.hours: Mon-Wed 9am-4pm; Thu 9am-6pm. Last clothing sign-in 30 min before close.

resources.name: House of Neighborly Service - clothing (Berthoud)
resources.description: Free clothing and emergency help at the Berthoud desk (hosted at Grace Place). Ask the Resource Navigator. Same site as the Berthoud pantry.
resources.address: 375 Meadowlark Dr, Berthoud, CO 80513

resources.name: Salvation Army Loveland - clothes and hygiene
resources.description: Clothes, hygiene kits, diapers, and snacks at the Loveland service desk. Ask Olga or the person at the front. Call first so they know what size and what you need.
resources.address: 840 N Lincoln Ave, Suite 101, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Crossroads Ministry - clothing help (Estes Park)
resources.description: Not a walk-in closet. Call to set an intake. If you qualify, they issue a voucher for clothes and household goods, often used at Good Neighbor Thrift. Bring ID, proof you live in the Estes Valley, and proof of income if you have it.
resources.address: 1753 Wildfire Rd, Estes Park, CO 80517
resources.hours: Mon-Thu 10am-4pm; Fri 10am-1pm. Call for an appointment.

resources.name: St. John's Lutheran clothing closet
resources.description: Free clothing closet next to the Tuesday pantry. No proof of income. Same church as the food pantry on Elizabeth Street.
resources.address: 305 E Elizabeth St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Larimer County Community Corrections
resources.description: Residential and day-reporting programs instead of, or after, jail or prison. Front desk can tell you how to report, visit, or drop belongings. Men's and women's residential units are in the same building. Ask the admin desk.
resources.address: 2255 Midpoint Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80525
resources.hours: Admin desk business hours; facility staffed 24/7

resources.name: Larimer County Probation
resources.description: 8th Judicial District probation. Call the Prospect Park office first if you do not know which officer you have. Loveland reports at 810 E 10th inside the police/courts building (970-622-2150). Midpoint office is 970-494-3960.
resources.address: 1600 Prospect Park Way, Suite 109, Fort Collins, CO 80525

resources.name: Colorado Parole - Fort Collins office
resources.description: State parole office for people releasing to Larimer County. After hours, call C-WISE at 1-800-426-9143 and leave a message for your officer. Bring your release papers the first time you report.
resources.address: 3000 S College Ave, Suite 110, Fort Collins, CO 80525

resources.name: C-WISE (parole & reentry line)
resources.description: 24-hour Colorado DOC line to reach a parole officer, ask about a release date, or ask for the Community Re-Entry Specialist at your parole office. They can help with housing, work clothes, and job leads after prison.

resources.name: Larimer County Alternative Sentencing
resources.description: Work release, electronic home detention, community service hours, and pretrial check-ins. Front desk is at Door 1, just west of the jail. Ask which program you were ordered into. Payments can be made at the same counter.
resources.address: 2307 Midpoint Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80525
resources.hours: Walk-in hours vary by unit; pretrial 9am-5pm daily

resources.name: Colorado State Public Defender - Fort Collins
resources.description: Free criminal defense if you cannot afford a lawyer in Larimer County. Call and press 0, or walk in and fill out an application. They do not take civil cases (eviction, benefits). Ask about record sealing after your case.
resources.address: 1 Old Town Square, Suite 201, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Arc Thrift Stores - Loveland
resources.description: Used furniture, dishes, clothes, and household goods. Proceeds support people with developmental disabilities. Donation drop-off at the same lot.
resources.address: 3131 N Garfield Ave, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Treasure Exchange (HNS thrift)
resources.description: Low-cost clothing, shoes, and home goods open to anyone. This is the paid shop; free clothing for HNS clients is the boutique after you see a navigator. Purchases support the pantry next door.
resources.address: 1511 E 11th St, Suite 100, Loveland, CO 80537

resources.name: Good Neighbor Thrift (Estes Park)
resources.description: Used clothes, furniture, and household goods. Run by Crossroads Ministry; sales help Estes Valley neighbors. If you need a voucher instead of paying, start with a Crossroads intake on Wildfire Road.
resources.address: 1138 Manford Ave, Unit A, Estes Park, CO 80517

resources.name: Eco-Thrift - Fort Collins
resources.description: Used furniture, household goods, and clothes on Howes Street downtown. Call before you haul a couch so they can tell you what they will take.
resources.address: 314 N Howes St, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Energy Resource Center - weatherization
resources.description: Free insulation, furnace, and energy-saving work for income-qualified homes in Larimer County. If you already get LEAP, SNAP, SSI, TANF, AND, or OAP you may skip extra income paperwork. Mail or drop the application at the Berthoud office.
resources.address: 320 Gateway Dr, Unit B, Berthoud, CO 80513
resources.hours: Mon-Fri business hours; call before you drive out

resources.name: Poudre Valley REA - bill help
resources.description: Electric co-op for Wellington, rural Fort Collins, and nearby lines. Ask a member-service person for a payment plan or LEAP/Energy Outreach referral. Press 3 for a person. Lobby is on REA Parkway.
resources.address: 7649 REA Pkwy, Fort Collins, CO 80528

resources.name: Estes Park Utility Billing
resources.description: Town electric and water bills. Ask billing about a payment plan. For shutoff help, also call Crossroads Ministry (970-577-0610) or Energy Outreach Colorado. This desk does not run a separate grant of its own.
resources.address: 170 MacGregor Ave, Estes Park, CO 80517

resources.name: Fort Collins VA Clinic
resources.description: VA primary care at Research Boulevard. Press 2 for your care team, 4 to enroll, 3 for a nurse. Labs, mental health, women's health, and X-ray are not at this clinic — those are at the Loveland VA clinic. Mental health emergency: 988, then press 1.
resources.address: 2509 Research Blvd, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: Northern Colorado VA Clinic (Loveland)
resources.description: Larger VA clinic on Byrd Drive: primary care plus labs, mental health, women's health, and imaging. Fort Collins VA patients are often sent here for those services. DAV vans can ride you to appointments; ask the Larimer Veterans Service Office.
resources.address: 4575 Byrd Dr, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: VFW Post 1781 (Fort Collins)
resources.description: Veterans of Foreign Wars post. Stop by or call if you need a veteran to point you to claims help, honor guard, or local veteran groups. Meetings first Tuesday at 7pm. Claims paperwork still starts at the county Veterans Service Office on Oak Street.
resources.address: 603 Lesser Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Veterans Crisis Line
resources.description: 24-hour line for veterans, service members, and their families. Call 988 and press 1. You do not have to be enrolled in VA care. If you cannot speak, text 838255 (that is a text number, not this call button).

resources.name: DentaQuest - Health First Colorado dental
resources.description: If you have Health First Colorado (Medicaid) or CHP+, this line finds a dentist who takes your card and explains what is covered. Ask them to search Fort Collins or Loveland. Not a clinic — they book you somewhere that is.

resources.name: Colorado Mission of Mercy (free dental clinic)
resources.description: Volunteer dentists run free two-day clinics around Colorado for people who cannot afford care. Locations move each year. Call the hotline for the next date, what to bring, and whether they are taking denture patients. First come, first served the morning of.
resources.hours: Seasonal two-day clinics; call the hotline

resources.name: Trans Lifeline
resources.description: Peer line run by trans people. Call if you need someone trans to talk to, even if you are not in a crisis. Spanish: press 2. This is not 988; for medical emergencies still call 911.
resources.hours: See site for current hours (peer operators)

resources.name: One Colorado
resources.description: Statewide LGBTQ+ advocacy desk. They can point you to health, school, and legal resources in Colorado, including Northern Colorado Pride groups. Not a 24-hour crisis line.
resources.address: 303 E 17th Ave, Suite 400, Denver, CO 80203

resources.name: LGBT National Hotline
resources.description: Confidential peer support for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, and questioning people, plus family members. Use this when local Pride offices are closed. Youth can also use The Trevor Project listing in this app.

resources.name: Poudre Libraries - Wi-Fi hotspot checkout
resources.description: Borrow a hotspot (and often a Chromebook) for a week with a library card. Ask at Old Town, Harmony, or Council Tree, or call the Answer Center to place a hold. Data is wiped after each loan. Guest Wi-Fi inside the buildings does not need a card.
resources.address: 201 Peterson St, Fort Collins, CO 80524
resources.hours: See branch hours; holds via catalog or phone

resources.name: CSU Early Childhood Center
resources.description: Licensed care from 6 weeks through pre-K in the old Washington School. Waitlist is open to CSU families and Fort Collins-area residents. Older preschool seats go through Colorado Universal Preschool. Email eccinfo@colostate.edu for the waitlist; tours only after an offer.
resources.address: 223 S Shields St, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: CASA of Larimer County
resources.description: Court Appointed Special Advocates for children in the dependency and neglect system. Also Family Connections: supervised visits and safe exchanges at Harmony House. If you need a CASA volunteer or a supervised visit slot, call the office, not the courthouse line first.
resources.address: 3105 E Harmony Rd, Fort Collins, CO 80528

resources.name: Project Self-Sufficiency of Northern Colorado
resources.description: Coaching, school, and career help for low-income single parents in Larimer County. Apply online or walk into the Loveland office Mon-Thu. If you are not sure you qualify, call and ask for an advisor before you fill the long form.
resources.address: 1810 Boise Ave, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Nurse-Family Partnership (Larimer County)
resources.description: Free nurse visits for first-time moms, starting in pregnancy through the child's second birthday. Ask for the Nurse-Family Partnership supervisor at Larimer County Health. Voluntary — you can say no.
resources.address: 1525 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Poudre Libraries - Conversations in English
resources.description: Free English conversation groups for adults at all levels. Register by calling the Answer Center, at any branch desk, or on the library events calendar. Bring a library card if you have one; you can get a card the same day with ID.
resources.address: 201 Peterson St, Fort Collins, CO 80524
resources.hours: Class times change; call to register

resources.name: RMIAN detention hotline
resources.description: Rocky Mountain Immigrant Advocacy Network. Call if you or a family member is in immigration detention in Colorado (including Aurora). They do not take walk-ins. For a child's immigration case, use the main office line 303-433-2812.
resources.address: 7301 Federal Blvd, Suite 300, Westminster, CO 80030

resources.name: Free naloxone (Narcan) in Northern Colorado
resources.description: North Colorado Health Alliance mails two doses to Larimer County addresses and maps free kiosks. No prescription. You can also ask any pharmacy. For overdose right now, call 911. Questions go to the Alliance (no public phone on that page — use the form).
resources.hours: Mail and kiosks; pharmacies during store hours

resources.name: Colorado REAL ID - what to bring
resources.description: Star on a Colorado license or ID for flying domestically. Book a DMV appointment (Fort Collins or Loveland offices in this app). Bring original identity papers, your Social Security number, and two proofs of a Colorado street address from the last year. Call the DMV line if a document was rejected.
resources.hours: By appointment at a driver-license office

resources.name: Larimer County Clerk - marriage licenses
resources.description: Marriage and civil union licenses. Both people usually must come with photo ID. Fort Collins recording desk takes walk-ins; Loveland (200 Peridot) and Estes Park (1601 Brodie) are by appointment. Apply online first to save time. You will need the recorded license later for a name change at DMV and Social Security.
resources.address: 200 W Oak St, First Floor, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Northside Aztlan Community Center - indoor heat and AC
resources.description: City rec center on Willow. Public lobby and gym hours are a place to warm up or cool off when libraries are packed. Ask the front desk which rooms you can sit in without a membership. Confirm today's hours at 970-221-6256. Call 2-1-1 on extreme-weather days for official cooling/warming sites.
resources.address: 112 E Willow St, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: Salud Family Health - Estes Park dental
resources.description: Sliding-scale dental in Estes Park. Kids from the Estes Valley may get free dental through the Estes Park Salud Foundation — ask the front desk. Medicaid, CHP+, and Delta Dental are taken. Same building as medical. Closed 8-9am the first and third Wednesday.
resources.address: 1950 Redtail Hawk Dr, Estes Park, CO 80517

resources.name: FRCC child care help (CCAMPIS)
resources.description: Front Range students with kids 11 and under can apply for help paying a licensed child care bill. Email CCAMPIS@frontrange.edu. There is no daycare on the Larimer campus. Ask the CCAMPIS team which providers they can pay.
resources.address: 4616 S Shields St, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: Estes Valley Library - Wi-Fi hotspot checkout
resources.description: Borrow a hotspot for a week, plus public computers and free Wi-Fi in the building and parking lot (no password). Search the catalog for hotspot or ask the second-floor desk. You need a library card in good standing to take a hotspot home.
resources.address: 335 E Elkhorn Ave, Estes Park, CO 80517
resources.hours: See library hours; Wi-Fi outside is 24/7

resources.name: SMART Recovery - Fort Collins
resources.description: Free secular recovery meetings (not AA) at the Fort Collins Senior Center. Tell the front desk you are going to the Lupine Room. Wednesday 5:30-7pm and Friday 6:30-8pm. Family and friends meet Mondays. Email info@nocopeerrecovery.org if the center is closed.
resources.address: 1200 Raintree Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80526

resources.name: Poudre Valley Prenatal (Family Medicine Center)
resources.description: Prenatal care for low-income women in northern Larimer County, in the same building as UCHealth Family Medicine Center. Ask the front desk for Poudre Valley Prenatal. They help with Medicaid and WIC paperwork, prenatal visits, and you deliver at Poudre Valley Hospital.
resources.address: 1025 Pennock Pl, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: UCHealth Birth Center - Poudre Valley Hospital
resources.description: Hospital birth at PVH on Lemay. Vaginal birth, VBAC, C-section, high-risk delivery, and a Level III NICU. Ask for Labor and Delivery. Jacuzzi tubs are for labor — this desk does not list water birth of the baby. Nitrous (laughing gas) is an option. Tours and classes: 970-495-7500.
resources.address: 1024 S Lemay Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: UCHealth Birth Center - Medical Center of the Rockies
resources.description: Hospital birth in Loveland. Vaginal birth, VBAC, C-section, and a Level II special care nursery. Most labor rooms have a jacuzzi tub for labor — that is not the same as water birth of the baby. Ask for Labor and Delivery. Nitrous is an option.
resources.address: 2500 Rocky Mountain Ave, Loveland, CO 80538

resources.name: Banner Fort Collins - Labor and Delivery
resources.description: Hospital birth at Banner Fort Collins on Lady Moon Drive. Go to Labor and Delivery. Banner McKee in Loveland no longer delivers — come here. Ask the desk about vaginal birth, VBAC, and C-section.
resources.address: 4700 Lady Moon Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80528

resources.name: Peaceful Birth Company
resources.description: HypnoBirthing classes and birth and postpartum doulas in Fort Collins. Sliding scale and payment plans. They take Medicaid, CHP+, and Tricare for doula support. Call to ask which class or doula team fits. Office at 1419 Riverside Ave, Unit C.
resources.address: 1419 Riverside Ave Unit C, Fort Collins, CO 80524

resources.name: True North Birth and Wellness
resources.description: Home birth with Kim Windels, a certified nurse-midwife. Ask about a water birth at home if you want to labor or deliver in a pool. Prenatal visits are longer appointments. Call to see if home birth is a fit. Serves Northern Colorado; she comes to you.

resources.name: Golden Hour Midwifery
resources.description: Home birth with Camille Friason, a licensed midwife. The home-birth package includes a birth pool. Prenatal visits can be in the office at 921 E Prospect Rd or in your home. Serves about 25 miles from Fort Collins. Call for a consult.
resources.address: 921 E Prospect Rd, Fort Collins, CO 80525

resources.name: Jodia's Midwifery Services
resources.description: Home birth with Jodia Fedchock, a certified professional midwife. Prenatal, labor, birth, and six weeks of postpartum and newborn care at your house. Serves Fort Collins, Loveland, Wellington, and nearby towns. Call to see if you are a match.

resources.name: North Colorado Midwifery
resources.description: Home birth with Lynnette Chambers, a registered midwife listed on the Colorado Midwives Association directory for Loveland and Greeley. Prenatal, labor, postpartum, and newborn care. Call to ask if she covers your town.

resources.name: Salud MAMAS group prenatal
resources.description: Group prenatal visits at Salud — shared medical appointments with other pregnant patients, plus education. Ask the Fort Collins desk for MAMAS. Sliding scale, Medicaid, and Spanish. Same building as Salud medical on Blue Spruce.
resources.address: 1635 Blue Spruce Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80524
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 7am-6pm; ask for next MAMAS group

resources.name: Health First Colorado - doula benefit
resources.description: If you have Health First Colorado (Medicaid) or CHP+, a doula can be covered for pregnancy, labor, and up to a year after. Ask your clinic for a recommendation, then find a doula enrolled with Health First Colorado. Member line 1-800-221-3943.

resources.name: Colorado Midwives Association - find a midwife
resources.description: Statewide directory of licensed home-birth midwives, including Northern Colorado. Check a license at DORA before you hire anyone. This is a member list, not an endorsement.

resources.name: National Maternal Mental Health Hotline
resources.description: 24/7 call or text for pregnancy and postpartum mental health. Counselors, not a local clinic. English and Spanish. For in-person counseling in Larimer, also see Connections at the Health District (970-221-5551).

resources.name: Larimer County Elections
resources.description: The desk for the Nov 3, 2026 general election. Register, update your address, pick up a replacement ballot, or ask about ADA machines and keeping your address off public voter lists. 5th floor of 200 W Oak St. Call 970-498-7820 or email elections@larimer.gov.
resources.address: 200 W Oak St Suite 5100, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: GoVoteColorado.gov
resources.description: Register, check, or update your Colorado voter record online. Register by Oct 26, 2026 to get a mail ballot; after that, register in person at a vote center through Election Day, Nov 3. Spanish site is VayaVotarColorado.gov. You need a Colorado license/ID or the last four of your Social Security number.

resources.name: Larimer ballot boxes and vote centers
resources.description: Official map of 24-hour ballot boxes and in-person vote centers for the Nov 3, 2026 general election. Boxes are open until 7pm Election Day. Vote centers start opening Oct 19 (more sites Oct 30 and Nov 2); Election Day hours 7am-7pm. Postmarks do not count — the county must have your ballot by 7pm. South Transit Center at 4915 Fossil Blvd has a ballot box; Transfort there is fare-free.
resources.hours: Ballot boxes 24/7 until 7pm Nov 3; vote centers vary

resources.name: BallotTrax (track your mail ballot)
resources.description: Free texts, email, or calls when your mail ballot is sent, received, and accepted. Sign up on the county track-your-ballot page. If a signature does not match, they tell you how to fix it (cure) before the deadline.

resources.name: Colorado Secretary of State - Elections
resources.description: Statewide elections desk. Register at GoVoteColorado.gov, find a drop box in any county, and read the Know Your Rights booklet. Call 303-894-2200. General election is Tuesday, Nov 3, 2026.
resources.address: 1700 Broadway Suite 550, Denver, CO 80290

resources.name: Colorado ballot language hotline
resources.description: Interpreter reads the words on your ballot (not who to vote for). Spanish, Vietnamese, Korean, Chinese, and other languages. Call 303-860-6970, or ask an election judge at a vote center, or call Larimer Elections. Have your ballot with you. Open during the November election window.
resources.hours: During the November election; weekdays 8am-5pm; Election Day 7am-7pm

resources.name: Larimer military and overseas voting
resources.description: If you are stationed away or living outside the U.S., register and request a ballot with a Federal Post Card Application. Return by mail, email upload, or fax 970-498-7845. Email uocava@larimer.gov or call 970-498-7820. Ballots sent by 7pm Election Day can still arrive up to eight days later.

resources.name: VOTE411 (what's on your ballot)
resources.description: Nonpartisan personalized ballot from the League of Women Voters. Compare candidates and read ballot issues for your address. Not the county clerk — use GoVoteColorado.gov to register.

resources.name: League of Women Voters of Larimer County
resources.description: Nonpartisan voter toolkit, candidate forums, and ballot-issue talks. Registration drives at schools and community spots. Email vote@lwv-larimercounty.org. They point you to VOTE411 and GoVoteColorado.gov — they do not run the election.

resources.name: Larimer County election judges
resources.description: Paid poll-worker jobs for the Nov 3, 2026 general election. Apply on the county page through Election Day. Questions: elections@larimer.gov or 970-498-7820.
resources.address: 200 W Oak St Suite 5100, Fort Collins, CO 80521

resources.name: Colorado Know Your Voting Rights
resources.description: Secretary of State booklet (updated July 20, 2026): who can vote, mail ballots, drop boxes, in-person voting, and ID. Your ballot must arrive at the clerk by 7pm Election Day. If you are in line at a drop box or vote center by 7pm, they still take it.
